title: Event Confirmation & Lead Follow-Up Caller (Fluent English, US Clients)
description:
ABOUT US

The Nonprofit Guy helps nonprofit founders and executives start, fund, and grow their organizations through coaching, done-for-you services, and an online academy. We run weekly webinars and major virtual events with 500 to 1,000 registrants every week.



We use an AI calling assistant for basic confirmation calls. YOU are the human voice for our most important leads: people who have already bought from us, applied to our programs, or asked questions. Your job is to get them to show up live and connect the hottest ones with our sales team.



These are warm calls, not cold calls. Every person you call has registered for our event and agreed to be contacted.



SCHEDULE

Full time, 40 hours per week. Must work US Eastern Time business hours, including some evenings before live events. Our main webinar is on Mondays, so the days before it are our busiest.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



High-Intent Lead Calls

- Personally call our highest-value registrants: past buyers (such as workbook purchasers), program applicants, and anyone who asked a question

- Confirm they're attending live, remind them what they'll learn, and share the bonus for showing up

- Help them add the event to their calendar and text them the join link

- Build real rapport. These people already trust us, and your call should strengthen that.



AI Follow-Up Calls

- Call contacts our AI assistant flagged for a human: people who asked about programs or pricing, seemed confused, or wanted to talk to a real person

- Call registrants the AI couldn't reach before the event starts



No-Show and Rebooking Calls

- Call high-value registrants who missed the event and get them to the replay or the next session



Sales Handoff

- Spot buying signals and hand qualified leads to our sales team right away with clear notes

- Help book calls with our sales team when someone is ready to talk about our programs



CRM and Tracking (GoHighLevel)

- Make calls through our GoHighLevel dialer

- Log every call outcome the same day: confirmed, call back, rescheduled, hot lead, wrong number, do not call

- Keep tags and notes accurate so our automations and sales team have clean data

- Send a short end-of-day report: calls made, conversations, confirmations, and hot leads passed to sales



Compliance

- Follow our scripts and compliance rules exactly

- Honor every "do not call" request immediately and mark it in the CRM



HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

- 100 to 150 dials per day, with quality conversations over volume

- 100% of calls logged the same day

- Show rate of the leads you call compared to leads you don't

- Number of qualified leads passed to sales

- Zero compliance issues



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, natural accent. This is the most important requirement.

- 1+ year of call center, appointment setting, telemarketing, or customer service experience with US customers

- Warm, confident, and great at building rapport. You sound like a friendly person, not a script.

- Able to handle questions and light objections calmly

- Organized and accurate with CRM notes

- Quiet workspace, noise-canceling headset, and reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

- Available during US Eastern Time hours



BONUS

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM dialer

- Appointment setting experience for coaches, consultants, or high-ticket offers

- Experience with education, coaching, or nonprofit clients



PAY

$900 to $1,100 per month based on experience, plus a monthly bonus when show rates rise on the leads you call.



HIRING PROCESS

Voice recording review, then a live mock call, then a paid trial week.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. Send:



1. A voice recording (Vocaroo or Loom link) of you reading this script naturally, as if you're on a real call:



"Hi, is this Sarah? Hey Sarah, this is [your name] from The Nonprofit Guy. I saw you grabbed our grant workbook, and you're registered for our free training this Monday at 7pm Eastern on how to fund your nonprofit. I just wanted to personally make sure you're still planning to join us live, because Blake is going deeper on the exact steps from the workbook. Awesome! We're also giving a free grant checklist to everyone who stays until the end. Can I text you the link so it's easy to find?"



2. A second short recording (under 1 minute) answering this question in your own words: "Tell us about your best phone job and why you were good at it."



3. Answers to the screening questions below



4. Start your subject line with "Nonprofit Guy Caller"



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. A registrant says, "I'm not sure I'll have time, I'm really busy Monday." What do you say?

2. Someone answers and says, "Stop calling me." What do you do on the call and in the CRM?

3. During a confirmation call, someone asks, "How much does your program cost?" How do you handle it?

4. How many calls per day have you made in past jobs, and what was your contact or conversion rate?

5. Describe your work setup: internet speed, backup connection, headset, and workspace.

title: Experienced YouTube Video Editor | Long Form + Shorts
description:
Experienced YouTube Video Editor | Long Form + Shorts



Part Time | Remote | $6 USD per Hour | 10 Hours per Week



Initial commitment: 10 hours per week

Growth potential: Additional hours may become available as our production volume and business grow



ABOUT YEARS YOUNGER



Years Younger is a movement, mobility, strength, and performance longevity brand helping active adults stay strong, mobile, capable, confident, and adventurous.



We're actively growing our YouTube channel and looking for a skilled, experienced video editor with excellent creative judgment who can turn educational, talking-head, and movement-based footage into polished, engaging, professional videos.



This is primarily a video editing position, not a social media management or virtual assistant role.



I'm not looking for someone who simply knows how to cut clips together. I'm looking for an editor who understands visual storytelling, pacing, viewer retention, B-roll, music, dynamic text, motion graphics, and, equally important, when to keep editing simple.



Our audience appreciates expertise, sophistication, and authenticity. Our videos should reflect those qualities while being visually compelling and enjoyable to watch.





WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



You'll work on a variety of content, including:



* Long-form YouTube videos, including educational and talking-head content.

* Movement, mobility, strength, Pilates, GYROTONIC®, GYROKINESIS®, Qigong, and breathwork videos.

* YouTube Shorts and vertical social videos.

* Strong opening sequences and attention-grabbing hooks.

* B-roll sequences that visually reinforce what the speaker is teaching.

* Dynamic on-screen text, captions, motion graphics, and visual elements.

* Music and sound design that enhance the production without overpowering the content.

* Repurposing longer videos into polished, engaging short-form content.



Our goal is to create videos that hold attention, communicate valuable information clearly, and feel professional from beginning to end.





OUR EDITING STANDARDS



We're looking for an editor with strong technical skills and excellent visual judgment.



You should be able to demonstrate:



* Pacing and viewer retention: Create compelling openings, maintain visual interest, remove unnecessary pauses and repetition, and keep longer videos flowing naturally.

* Sophisticated text and graphics: Use attractive typography, animated text, motion graphics, and visual emphasis where appropriate. Text should feel intentional and dynamic, not static, overly simple, or repetitive.

* Excellent B-roll selection: Choose visuals that support the actual teaching, match the spoken content, and enhance understanding.

* Professional audio: Maintain clear dialogue, consistent volume, balanced music, and clean transitions between clips.

* Movement accuracy: Preserve exercise continuity and ensure that the demonstrated movement matches the instruction. Accurate synchronization of spoken words and visible movements is essential.

* Creative judgment: Know when to add visual energy and when to allow movement, instruction, and the speaker's personality to carry the video.

* Polished finishing: Deliver clean cuts, accurate captions, appropriate transitions, professional cropping, and consistent visual presentation.



Preserve the authentic appearance of the instructor, including facial features, body proportions, and movement accuracy. Do not use AI-generated facial alterations, body modifications, or beauty filters without prior approval.



We do not want videos overloaded with unnecessary effects, distracting graphics, random B-roll, or excessive stock footage.



At the same time, simply cutting footage together without thoughtful editing is not sufficient.



We're looking for an editor who can make a video more compelling without making it unnecessarily busy.





QUALITY CONTROL IS PART OF THE JOB



Before submitting a finished video, you are responsible for reviewing your own work carefully.



This includes checking:



* Audio levels and dialogue synchronization.

* Spelling, captions, graphics, and text placement.

* B-roll relevance and timing.

* Pacing, transitions, and awkward cuts.

* Movement continuity and visual accuracy.

* Cropping, framing, and export quality.

* The complete video from beginning to end.



All music, B-roll, stock footage, and graphics must be appropriately licensed or approved for commercial use. You must be able to identify the source of any third-party assets included in your edits.



Our expectation is to receive polished, publish-ready videos, not rough edits that require extensive corrections.



We welcome creative ideas, thoughtful recommendations, and an editor who takes pride in the finished product.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Qualifications and experience:



* At least 4 years of professional video editing experience preferred.

* A strong portfolio demonstrating complete long-form YouTube editing.

* Excellent short-form editing skills for YouTube Shorts and Reels.

* Experience with educational, talking-head, coaching, fitness, wellness, podcast, or personal-brand content.

* Strong B-roll selection, motion text, audio mixing, and creative pacing skills.

* An understanding of YouTube viewer retention and the importance of the first 30 seconds.

* Excellent attention to detail and professional quality control.

* Strong English comprehension and communication.

* Ability to follow established brand guidelines while contributing original creative ideas.

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

* Willingness to receive feedback, make accurate revisions, and meet agreed deadlines.

* Reliable communication and realistic time estimates.



We particularly value editors who can recognize opportunities to improve a video without needing detailed instructions for every cut, transition, or graphic.





EDITING SOFTWARE



You should be highly proficient in at least one professional video editing platform:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut



Experience with After Effects or professional motion graphics is a plus.



Descript experience is helpful but not required. We can train a strong editor on the portions of Descript used in our workflow.



You do not need to know every editing program. Your demonstrated editing ability, creative judgment, and quality of finished work are more important than the number of programs you know.





SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



This is a remote, ongoing, part-time position.



Starting pay: $6 USD per hour.



Expected workload: Approximately 10 hours per week, with the potential to increase to 12 hours as our production needs and working relationship develop.



Hours and project priorities will be agreed upon in advance.



You do not need to work entirely during U.S. business hours, but you must have reliable communication overlap during Pacific Time working hours.



My normal working day is approximately 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, Los Angeles.



We value organized, efficient work and an editor who can deliver high-quality results within realistic, agreed-upon timeframes.





COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS



Reliable, timely communication is essential and will be evaluated during both the hiring process and paid editing test.



During your agreed working hours, you are expected to acknowledge direct work messages within two hours.



This includes questions, file access issues, revision requests, project updates, and deadline-related communication.



You do not need to have a complete answer within two hours. A brief acknowledgment is sufficient, along with an estimated time for a more detailed response if necessary.



Messages received outside your scheduled working hours can be acknowledged at the beginning of your next scheduled work period.



If you encounter a problem that could affect an agreed deadline, you're expected to communicate it as soon as you become aware of it.



We also expect proactive progress updates on longer assignments rather than having to repeatedly ask about project status.



We're looking for someone who communicates professionally, takes responsibility for their work, and follows through on commitments.





PROJECT FILES AND DELIVERY



All production materials, completed video files, and approved final deliverables must be organized within our company-controlled Google Drive production system.



Editors must be willing and able to provide:



* Final exported videos in the agreed format and resolution.

* Editable project files and associated assets needed for continued editing or future revisions.

* Organized files and clear naming conventions.



Before beginning an assignment, you must confirm that your editing software supports a project handoff method that allows Years Younger to access and continue editing the work.



Projects must not remain accessible only through your personal editing account.



We want to establish a professional, organized production workflow where completed projects remain accessible to Years Younger.





PAID EDITING TEST



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test before a final hiring decision.



This is an actual Years Younger production assignment, not a hypothetical editing exercise.



Because we're actively publishing content, the goal is to create a polished, professional, publish-ready video.



Each test will include:



* Actual source footage and a clear editing brief.

* An agreed scope, authorized number of hours, payment, and deadline.

* An initial creative checkpoint to review the editing direction before the complete assignment is finished.

* Clear deliverable and project handoff requirements.



We'll evaluate creative judgment, editing quality, pacing, visual storytelling, audio, accuracy, communication, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver a finished video that meets our standards.



A professional portfolio is essential, but the ability to produce excellent work independently is what ultimately matters.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph messages only.



Please do not
 the address associated with this account. Shortlisted applicants will receive instructions for the next step.



Use "Years Younger Video Editor" as your application subject line.



Please answer the following questions.





1. VIDEO PORTFOLIO, DIRECT GOOGLE DRIVE LINKS REQUIRED



Provide links to:



* Two complete long-form YouTube videos you personally edited.

* Two strong short-form videos, such as YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels, that you personally edited.



IMPORTANT: DIRECT GOOGLE DRIVE VIDEO LINKS ARE REQUIRED.



Please provide direct Google Drive links to the actual video files.



Do not submit a Canva website or Canva portfolio as a substitute for these links.



Canva portfolio websites and embedded video previews frequently fail to load correctly or do not allow me to review the entire video.



You may include your Canva portfolio as additional information, but I still require direct Google Drive links to all four video examples.



Before submitting your application, please verify that:



* Each Google Drive link opens directly to the actual video file.

* Sharing permissions are set to "Anyone with the link can view."

* Each video loads and plays correctly from beginning to end.

* Your two long-form examples are complete videos, not shortened previews, demo reels, or highlight compilations.

* Your video links do not require access approval or special permissions.



Applications without accessible, direct Google Drive video links may not be reviewed.





2. YOUR PERSONAL CONTRIBUTION



For each of the four video examples, briefly explain exactly what you personally handled.



For example, did you perform the complete edit, initial cuts, B-roll selection, graphics, animation, color correction, audio mixing, captions, or final finishing?





3. CREATIVE JUDGMENT



Choose one of your long-form video examples and identify one specific timestamp where you made an editing decision you're particularly proud of.



Tell me what you did at that moment and why you made that choice.



I'm interested in understanding how you think as an editor, not simply which software you know.





4. EXPERIENCE AND SOFTWARE



How many years have you worked professionally as a video editor?



Which editing programs do you currently use, and which one is your primary editing platform?





5. EDITORIAL APPROACH



Briefly explain how you approach B-roll selection, pacing, motion text, music, graphics, and transitions in an educational talking-head YouTube video.



How do you make the content more interesting and improve viewer retention without distracting from the speaker?





6. AVAILABILITY AND COMPENSATION



Please confirm:



* That $6 USD per hour works for you.

* That approximately 10 hours per week works for you.

* Your normal working days and hours, shown in Pacific Time.

* That you can spread 10 hours over 3 days each week  4 hours on Day 1, 4 hours on Day 2, and 2 hours on Day 3 for revisions, final quality control, and delivery

* Your availability for communication between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM Pacific Time.

* Any other jobs or regular client commitments that affect your availability.

* Your earliest available start date.





7. QUALITY CONTROL



Briefly explain the steps you take to check a completed video for errors before submitting it to a client.





8. ATTENTION TO DETAIL



Somewhere in your response about your editorial approach, naturally include the word spine.



Please use it in a complete, relevant sentence rather than adding it separately.



This helps us identify applicants who have read the instructions carefully.





FINAL NOTE



We're looking for someone interested in developing a long-term working relationship and contributing to the growth of Years Younger.



This is an opportunity for an editor who enjoys thoughtful, creative work, cares about quality, communicates professionally, and takes genuine pride in creating videos that people want to watch.



Concise, specific applications are welcome. Please check all your Google Drive video links before submitting.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a brief, two-minute introduction video explaining their editing experience and walking through one creative decision from their portfolio.



Finalists will then be considered for a paid production test with an agreed scope, compensation, and deadline.



Thank you,



Kerri



Founder, Years Younger

title: Experienced Cold Caller
description:
Experienced Cold Callers Only — Appointment Setter, UK Tradespeople Outreach (Part-Time)



Company: Market Engine HQ

Job Type: Part-time to start (~20 hours/week, Monday to Friday), with scope to move up to more hours as you prove yourself.

Schedule: Must be available within UK daytime hours. Target shift: roughly 3pm to 7pm or 4pm to 8pm Philippine time (this shifts by an hour either side depending on UK daylight saving, we’ll confirm exact times at interview).

Pay: Commission from your very first call. Base salary of £2.50/hour starts after your first confirmed sale. Paid weekly via Wise, in GBP.



Commission:



£50 for every website sold (confirmed, paid client)

£10 for every website presentation you book, but only if the client actually shows up to the meeting



About this role



We help UK tradespeople (plumbers, electricians, builders, roofers and similar) get a professional website built around their reviews and services. You’ll be calling UK business owners, following our script, and booking them in for a short video presentation where our team shows them their fully custom website and closes the sale.



We’ll be upfront: this role is for experienced cold callers only. If you’ve never cold called before, or you find it hard to stick to a script while still sounding like a real person, this isn’t the right job for you, and that’s completely fine, it just means this one isn’t a match.



If you do have cold calling experience and can genuinely master a script, this is a strong earning opportunity. There’s no cap on commission, and the better you get at handling the call, the more you take home. All calls are recorded, both to help you improve and to keep things fair and accountable on both sides.



What you’ll be doing



Calling a provided list of UK business owners through our CloudTalk dialer (seat provided, no cost to you)

Following our call script closely while still sounding natural and relaxed, not robotic

Handling common objections (already have a website elsewhere, not interested, too busy) using the responses we give you

Booking qualified meetings into our calendar system

Logging the outcome of every call accurately (we only pay booking commission on genuine, attended meetings, so honest logging matters)



What we’re looking for



Previous cold calling experience is required. Tell us what you called for, who you called, and roughly how long you did it

Clear, confident spoken English that a UK business owner will find easy to understand

Proven ability to follow a script while still sounding like a real person, not reading word for word

A good quality headset. You’ll need to show this on camera at interview

Reliable laptop, stable internet connection, and a quiet place to make calls (background noise is an instant red flag for us)

Most calls will end in a no. You’ll need to stay positive and keep your energy up for the next call, every time



How to apply



Send your CV along with a short voice recording (60 to 90 seconds). In it, either read out a short script line we’ll provide, or just talk us through your cold calling experience so we can hear how you sound on a call. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: MCA Sales Rep / Deal Submission Specialist (Merchant Cash Advance Experience REQUIRED)
description:
We're a US-based merchant cash advance and business funding brokerage. We work with small business owners across the country to get them working capital fast, and we submit to a wide network of direct funders. We're growing and need a rep who already knows this industry — not someone we have to teach it to.

- Call/Text and work inbound/outbound leads of business owners seeking capital

- Present offers to merchants, explain factor rate, payback, term, and daily/weekly ACH payments clearly

- Close the deal, get contracts signed, and coordinate through to funding

- **Minimum 1 year of hands-on merchant cash advance experience** — at an ISO, broker shop, or direct funder. This is non-negotiable.

-Fluent in English

- You know the vocabulary cold: stips, MID, UCC, 1st/2nd/3rd position, buy rate vs. sell rate, factor rate, holdback, consolidation, reverse consolidation, syndication, COJ, decline reasons

- You can read a bank statement and tell me in 60 seconds whether a deal is fundable and roughly what it'll get approved for

- Proven phone sales experience — you're comfortable pitching, handling objections, and asking for the signature

- Excellent spoken English with a neutral or light accent (you'll be on the phone with US business owners all day)

- Comfortable in a CRM. GoHighLevel experience is a big plus

- Reliable high-speed internet, backup power/internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace

- Can work US Eastern Time hours consistently



**NICE TO HAVE**



- Existing relationships or familiarity with specific funders' buy boxes

- Experience with dialers, VOIP systems, and lender portals

- Background in equipment financing, term loans, LOC, or SBA



**WHAT WE OFFER**



- monthly base salary

- Commission on every funded deal — top performers earn significantly more than base

- Steady lead flow — you're not cold prospecting from scratch

- Long-term position with a growing company, not a short-term project

- Paid training on our specific lender network and process





We move fast on good candidates. If you're the real deal, you'll hear from us within a few days.

title: Chief of Staff / Operations & Project Manager (Hands-On, Remote, UK Hours) - Ticket distribution company
description:
About us

We’re a small, fast-moving startup in the ticket distribution industry, operating on UK hours. We’ve built a business that works, and we’re now preparing for our next stage of growth. To get there, we need our operations to run more smoothly, more predictably, and with less dependence on the founder day to day.



The role

You’ll be the founder’s right hand, with one clear purpose: make sure the business runs flawlessly and is ready to scale. This is a high commitment high reward role for a rockstar leader.



In practice, that means:

- Streamlining processes. Mapping how work actually flows across our Operations and Development teams, removing friction, and building clear, repeatable ways of working.

- Ensuring operations run smoothly. Overseeing the day-to-day, keeping teams organised and accountable, and making sure nothing falls through the gaps.

- Anticipating issues. Spotting risks, bottlenecks and slipping deadlines before they become problems, and dealing with them early.

- Escalating when needed, and finding solutions. Knowing what to handle yourself, what to resolve with the team, and what genuinely needs the founder’s decision, and arriving with a recommendation rather than just a problem.

- Owning our ClickUp. Our ClickUp workspace is the backbone of how we operate. You’ll own it fully: structure, workflows, automations, dashboards and adoption across the team.

- When needed, you’ll step in and execute yourself, whether that’s building an automation, writing an SOP, or covering an operational task when the team is stretched.



Oversee and keep teams accountable

Organise each team’s workflow so it’s clear who owns what, by when, and what “done” looks like

Track commitments across Ops and Dev, follow up on missed deadlines, and escalate blockers early

Run weekly team check-ins and make sure agreed actions get done

Report to the founder honestly on what’s on track, what’s slipping, and why



Project management

Plan and run projects end to end: scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, risks and resources

Apply sound project management practice, adapted to a small startup rather than applied rigidly

Manage the development pipeline: backlog grooming, sprint or cycle planning, prioritisation, and release coordination with the developers

Translate business requirements from the founder and the Ops team into clear, well-scoped tasks the developers can act on



ClickUp and systems

Own and improve our ClickUp workspace: structure, spaces, lists, custom fields, views, templates, automations and forms

Make sure every team uses ClickUp consistently and that it reflects what’s actually happening

Build dashboards and reports so the founder can see priorities, progress and blockers at a glance



Workflow mapping and AI



Map how work actually flows across teams, from request to delivery, using clear process maps (e.g. swimlane diagrams or flowcharts)

Identify steps that are manual, repetitive or error-prone, and redesign them

Find and implement practical uses of AI in our workflows, such as automating task intake, summarising updates, drafting SOPs, or generating reports

Build and maintain automations that connect our tools (ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace and others), including AI-powered steps where they add value

Document every workflow and automation so the team understands how it works and it doesn’t depend on one person



Processes and operations



Document and maintain internal processes and SOPs, and keep them up to date as workflows change

Identify bottlenecks and recurring problems and implement practical fixes

Execute operational tasks directly when needed, especially during busy periods

Onboard new team members onto our tools and ways of working



Founder support



Be the team’s first point of contact so the founder doesn’t need to be involved in day-to-day decisions

Prepare weekly summaries covering progress, risks and decisions needed

Handle confidential information with discretion



What we’re looking for



4+ years in project management, operations management, chief of staff or a similar role

Formal project management knowledge, ideally with a recognised certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, Scrum Master/PSM, or equivalent)

Experience managing or coordinating a software development team, even a small one

Hands-on experience setting up and managing ClickUp, beyond simply using it (please describe what you built)

Experience mapping and redesigning business workflows

Practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day work (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, ClickUp Brain) and building AI-assisted workflows

Working knowledge of at least one automation platform, such as Zapier, Make or n8n

Exceptionally organised: you keep clean systems, clear documentation and tight follow-up as a matter of habit

Willing to execute work yourself when needed, not only delegate it

Confident holding people accountable, politely but firmly, including people more technical than you

Excellent written and spoken English



Nice to have



A technical background (computer science, IT, or previous work as a developer, QA or business analyst)

Experience building more advanced automations, such as multi-step n8n or Make scenarios, API integrations, or AI agents

Experience in a startup or small, fast-paced team

Background in ticketing, e-commerce or live entertainment



What we offer



- Full-time, long-term remote position

- Best in class Benefits

- Yearly offsite

- Direct work with the founder and real ownership of how the business operates

- Room to grow as the company grows



To apply please send:

- Your CV

- A short description of a ClickUp workspace you set up or significantly improved

- Apply with 9 Application points

title: E-commerce Website Operations Manager – Shopify Site
description:
Full-time, remote | $1,500–$2,200 USD per month



VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY (see below)



About Park Ave Appliance



Park Ave Appliance is an online major-appliance retailer based in New Jersey. We sell refrigerators, ranges, washers, dryers, dishwashers and other major appliances through 
.



We are looking for a very sharp, responsible person to take ownership of the day-to-day operation of our e-commerce website.



This is not a developer position. We are looking for someone who understands e-commerce, notices details, learns quickly, solves problems, and follows things through until they are completely finished.



The job



You will work directly with the owner and help make sure the website is accurate, current and working properly every day.

Your responsibilities will include:



• Keep promotions, manufacturer rebates, pricing, banners and sale pages current.

• Review product pages and collections for incorrect pricing, missing information, images, stock issues, broken links and other problems.

• Build and update sale pages, brand pages, collections and other website content.

• Test the website regularly on desktop and mobile and catch problems before customers do.

• Work with spreadsheets and CSV files for product and pricing updates.

• Keep track of open website issues and follow up until they are completely resolved.

• Notice problems yourself instead of waiting for someone to point them out.

• Learn new systems and figure things out when there is no step-by-step instruction.

• Communicate clearly with the owner about what you are working on, what is completed and what still needs attention.



We are not looking for somebody who simply waits for a task list.

If you notice something is wrong, investigate it. If you can fix it, fix it. If you need help from somebody else, follow up until it is done.



Who we are looking for

• Experience working with an e-commerce website.

• Shopify experience is strongly preferred.

• You do not need to have previously held the title “E-commerce Manager.” A very smart, capable person who learns quickly can be a great fit.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Good Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Comfortable learning software and figuring out technical problems.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Organized and able to keep track of many small details without dropping things.

• A self-starter who takes responsibility and finishes what they start.

• Comfortable speaking directly with the owner and giving honest feedback when you think something should be done differently.



Experience with HTML, CSS, Liquid, Google Merchant Center, product feeds or manufacturer rebates is helpful, but not required.



Hours

All hours are U.S. Eastern Time:

• Sunday: 11:00 AM–4:00 PM

• Monday–Thursday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM

• Friday: 10:00 AM–1:00 PM

Some flexibility may be possible.



Pay



$1,500–$2,200 USD per month, depending on experience, ability and level of responsibility.

Strong candidates will be considered toward the top of the range.

Paid time off is agreed individually.



How to apply



VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY

Please do not apply by only sending your resume.

We are receiving a large number of applications, and applications without a video will not be reviewed.

Please send a short video, about one minute, answering the two questions below.

The video does not need to be professional or edited. A simple phone video is completely fine. We are not judging your camera skills. We just want to hear you speak naturally and understand your experience and how you think.

1. Why do you think this job is a good fit for you?

What experience do you have that makes you feel you would be good at this position?

Please briefly explain what you have done in e-commerce, Shopify, website management, operations, or any similar work that you think is relevant.

2. We are specifically looking for someone who is exceptionally bright, learns very quickly, and understands things deeply.

Do you believe that describes you?

Why?

How do you know?

Please give one real example from your work or life that shows this.

Please upload the video to Loom, Google Drive, YouTube (unlisted), or anywhere else you prefer and include the link with your application.

Applications without the video link will not be reviewed.



This is a long-term position with real responsibility and room to grow. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the company and stay with us long-term.



Thanks so much for your time. I really appreciate it.



Shimi

Park Ave Appliance is an online major-appliance retailer based in New Jersey, selling refrigerators, ranges, washers, dryers, dishwashers and other major appliances through 
.

These are important, high-ticket purchases. Customers often have questions before buying and sometimes need help after the order is placed.

We are looking for a very sharp, confident salesperson who can sell, think quickly, take ownership of customers, and solve problems without needing to be told every step.

The job

You will be one of the main people speaking with customers who shop on our website.

A large part of the job is sales: helping shoppers choose the right appliance, answering questions, comparing products, overcoming hesitation and closing the order.

But your responsibility does not end when the customer pays.

You will also help make sure orders go through properly and that customers are taken care of when something changes or goes wrong.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Speak with shoppers by phone, chat and
 and turn conversations into orders.

- Understand what the customer actually needs and help them choose the right product.

- Compare models and explain differences clearly without overwhelming the customer.

- Follow up with shoppers who asked questions or did not complete their purchase.

- Offer appropriate add-ons and upgrades, including installation, haul-away, protection plans and matching products.

- Review incoming website orders for pricing, availability, address information and delivery details.

- Contact customers quickly when an order needs attention.

- Handle backorders, delivery issues, product changes and other problems.

- Keep customers informed even when you do not yet have the final answer.

- Follow every customer issue until it is actually resolved.

- Communicate clearly with our team so everyone knows what is happening with an order.

- Handle several chats, calls and orders at the same time without dropping things.

- Learn our products and industry quickly.



Different customers need different types of conversations.

Some customers want every specification and want to compare several models. Others simply want you to tell them which washer or refrigerator is good and help them make a decision quickly.

A strong salesperson understands the person they are speaking with and adjusts accordingly.

This is not an order-entry job.

We need someone who thinks.

If you do not know an answer, figure out how to find it.

If something goes wrong with an order, take ownership of it.

If you are waiting for someone else, follow up.

If you see a problem, do not wait for somebody to tell you what to do.



Who we are looking for

- Strong experience in sales, customer service, or another customer-facing role.

- Experience selling by phone, chat or
.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Comfortable and natural speaking with American customers.

- Very smart, quick-thinking and able to learn new products and systems quickly.

- Strong common sense and judgment.

- A natural salesperson who enjoys closing sales.

- Someone who genuinely cares that the customer is taken care of after the sale as well.

- Strong follow-up. You do not forget open issues.

- Organized and able to multitask.

- Comfortable working quickly in a busy environment.

- Able to solve problems independently instead of immediately asking a manager what to do.

- Reliable and responsive with coworkers and management.

- Comfortable using online systems, chat,
 and e-commerce tools.

Experience with appliances, furniture, electronics, e-commerce or another high-ticket product is a strong plus.



Hours

This is a 40-hour-per-week position working U.S. Eastern Time:

Sunday: 11:00 AM–4:00 PM

Monday–Thursday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM

Friday: 10:00 AM–1:00 PM

For applicants in the Philippines, this is an overnight schedule.

Please apply only if you are comfortable working these hours consistently, staying fully awake and focused throughout your shift, and making this schedule part of your normal routine.

Some flexibility may be possible.



Pay

$1,200–$1,800 USD per month, depending on experience, ability and overall fit.

Strong candidates will be considered toward the top of the range.

Paid time off is agreed individually.



VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY

Please do not apply by only sending your resume. We receive many applications, and applications without the required video will not be reviewed.

Record a short video, about 1 minute, answering the two questions below. A simple phone video is fine. Speak naturally and do not read a prepared script.

1. This is a senior sales position. We are looking for a highly skilled, very experienced salesperson with many years of real selling behind them — not someone starting out. Are you that person? Tell me about your sales experience, and tell me is this job the right fit for you? How do you know that?

2. Above everything else, we are looking for someone who is very, very smart. Are you that person? How do you know?

Upload your video to Loom, Google Drive, YouTube (unlisted), or anywhere else you prefer and include the link with your application. Applications without the video link will not be reviewed.

description:

MSTR (

title: Google Ads + CRO Expert for U.S. Healthcare Lead Generation
description:
I’m looking for a top-tier Google Ads operator to help manage and optimize lead-generation campaigns for a healthcare company in the United States.



This is an active account already generating leads, and I’m looking for someone who can think beyond campaign management and look at the entire funnel - campaign structure, search terms, bidding, conversion tracking, landing pages, form flow, messaging, and ultimately lead quality and booked appointments.



**What I’m looking for**



You should be highly experienced with:

- Google Ads for lead generation

- Search campaigns

- Keyword and search-term strategy

- Match types and negative keyword management

- Bidding strategy

- Conversion tracking and attribution

- Budget allocation and scaling

- Diagnosing poor lead quality

- Landing page optimization / CRO

- Form optimization

- Analyzing the full path from click → lead → booked appointment / sale

You should be comfortable looking beyond surface-level metrics like CTR and CPC.



I care about things like:

- Cost per qualified lead

- Cost per booked appointment

- Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

- Lead quality

- Overall funnel conversion rate

- Whether the campaigns are actually driving business results



**The kind of person I want**

I’m specifically looking for someone who is proactive and strategic.



If your working style is waiting for me to tell you which keywords to pause or which ads to test, this probably isn’t a good fit.



I want someone who can look at an account and say:

“Here’s what I think is happening. Here are the three biggest opportunities. Here’s what I’d test first, and here’s why.”



You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, spotting problems, and bringing ideas to the table.



CRO experience matters



You do not need to be a full-time conversion-rate optimizer, but you should be able to review a landing page and identify obvious issues with:

- Messaging

- Page structure

- Calls to action

- Form friction

- Mobile experience

- Trust

- Conversion flow



If the ads are doing their job but the page is leaking leads, I want you to recognize that.



What the role would look like



Initially, I’d like you to:

- Audit the existing Google Ads account

- Review the current landing pages and conversion flow

- Identify the biggest immediate opportunities

- Put together a clear optimization plan

- Help implement and manage the changes

- Provide ongoing recommendations based on performance



If it’s a strong fit, this can become an ongoing relationship.



I’m not looking for the cheapest person. I’m looking for someone who is very good at this and can demonstrate that through the way they think and the results they’ve produced.



**Growth opportunity:**

If this goes well and you’re interested, there may be opportunities to take on more accounts and a broader role over time. I work across several lead-generation businesses and would be very open to expanding the relationship with the right person



**How to apply**



Please include:

- A short overview of your Google Ads experience, specifically with lead-generation campaigns

- A few examples of accounts you’ve worked on and the results you achieved

- Any examples where you improved performance through landing-page or CRO changes, not just ad optimization

- A Loom video explaining:

  - why you’re interested in this position

  - your approach to auditing and improving a lead-gen Google Ads account

  - examples of past campaigns you’ve worked on and the results you produced



**I care much more about how you think and what you’ve actually accomplished than certifications or generic agency credentials.**

title: Co-Host / Operations Manager — Guest Experience & Team Lead
description:
The Problem We Need Solved



We run a growing short-term rental business — 18+ units across the East Coast in the United States — and for our guests, the experience begins the 
nt they hit "send" on their very first message. But we've outgrown our current setup:



- Messages need to be answered fast, warmly, and like a real human — not a copy-paste script.

- When something goes sideways, someone has to stay calm and make it right before it becomes a bad review.

- Our small VA team is talented but needs a leader to keep everyone rowing in the same direction.

- Our systems and SOPs need an owner who improves them — not just someone who follows them.



That's where you come in. We're not looking for a "virtual assistant." We're looking for a right-hand operator — a Co-Host who treats our guests like their own and our business like they've got skin in the game.



Your Mission



Be the voice our guests trust and the operator who keeps everything running behind the scenes. You are the first person a guest hears from — and the last line of defense before a small hiccup turns into a one-star surprise.



You'll…



- Own the full guest journey — inquiry, booking, check-in, mid-stay, and checkout — with fast, warm, genuinely human communication.

- Jump on a call when a message won't cut it, and resolve issues calmly in real time.

- Turn frustrated guests into 5-star reviews through sincere, thoughtful recovery.

- Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, and property teams so every turnover is guest-ready.

- Lead, train, and hold accountable a small team of VAs.

- Build and refine the SOPs that make our operation faster and tighter as we scale.

- Spot bottlenecks and bring us ideas on pricing, scheduling, and workflow.

- Handle light social media and admin as needed.



Real Talk — The Heart of This Job



Let's be upfront about what this role actually is: you'll be on the phone with upset guests often. A booking went sideways, the check-in code won't work, the unit isn't what they pictured — and you're the calm, confident voice on the other end. If phone calls with frustrated people wear you down, this isn't the role for you. If you thrive on turning tension into gratitude and finding a fix nobody else spotted, keep reading.



To do this well, you'll need:



- A neutral, no-accent English speaking voice. Guests should never have to strain to understand you. This one is non-negotiable.

- Real de-escalation instincts. You can take someone from furious to thankful in a single conversation, without ever losing your cool.

- Creative problem-solving under pressure. When there's no obvious answer, you invent one — fast, and on your feet.



This Role Is Perfect for Someone Who…



- Can turn an upset guest saying "the AC won't turn on" into a guest who still leaves five stars.

- Reads the emotion behind a message and knows exactly when to type and when to pick up the phone.

- Gets a little rush from closing out a tense situation with one calm, kind reply.

- Treats a clean inbox and a fully-confirmed turnover calendar as a personal win.

- Leads a team the way they'd want to be led — clear, kind, and accountable.

- Constantly asks, "What else can I solve here before anyone even has to ask?"



What You Bring



- Hands-on short-term rental experience (Airbnb, VRBO, 
, or similar).

- Excellent written and spoken English with a truly neutral, no-accent speaking voice — this is non-negotiable, because you'll be on live calls with guests daily.

- Genuine phone confidence. You'll be making and taking calls with upset guests every day, and staying calm under fire is the job — not the exception.

- Proven de-escalation and creative problem-solving. You can turn furious into grateful, and improvise a fix when there's no playbook for the situation in front of you.

- Leadership experience running a small (virtual) team and keeping people accountable.

- Tech-savvy across hospitality platforms — PMS/messaging tools, calendars, Slack, WhatsApp, 
, Hospitable, and the like.

- High EQ, real warmth, and a genuine passion for hospitality.



Your Setup



- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, a second monitor, and a noise-canceling headset.

- Available for daytime coverage in our market's time zone (US East)— guest issues don't keep office hours.



Compensation & Growth



- Competitive monthly salary (based on experience) plus performance bonuses tied to review scores and guest satisfaction.

- This is a long-term seat with a real path into Operations Lead / Regional roles as we grow. You won't just run the standards — you'll help shape them.



How We Hire



We don't hire off a resume — we hire off mindset.



How do you take feedback? We love people who grow from clear, kind communication.

How do you make decisions? You'll act independently, but always with care.

What's your default mode? Our favorite people ask, "What else can I own here?"



To Apply



Please send both (applications missing either won't be considered):

- Your resume/CV.

- A 1–2 minute English introduction video or voice sample introducing yourself and telling us why this role is the one for you.



NOTE: must be available US EST Day Time and looking for 7 days a week of coverage.

title: Property Accountant (AppFolio)
description:
About the role



A U.S. property management firm is launching a new third-party management division and needs a property accountant to own its books in AppFolio from the start. The portfolio is multifamily, with retail assets to follow. You'll keep the books for every property and every owner, close monthly on a full accrual basis, and make sure owners are paid accurately and on time.

This is an ownership role. The books are being set up fresh, so the firm wants someone who arrives with a view on how they should be built, explains the reasoning behind it, and writes the process down so it runs the same way every month.



What you'll own



• Trust account and bank reconciliations, every month

• Accounts payable: entering bills and preparing payment batches for approval. The firm approves every payment before it is released

• Owner distributions and management fee calculations

• Monthly owner statements

• The monthly accrual close in AppFolio

• Keeping AppFolio clean: chart of accounts, property and owner setup, tenant and vendor ledgers

• Onboarding new properties and owners into AppFolio

• Written SOPs for the close and every recurring process you run



What you need



• Day-to-day experience doing property accounting in AppFolio

• A working command of the fundamentals: bank and trust reconciliations, AP, owner distributions and the monthly accrual close

• An understanding of trust account structures (one master trust account, one per property, or one per owner), the trade-offs between them, and the judgment to recommend one and defend it

• Ownership. You treat the books as yours and act like it

• A solution-oriented approach. You bring ideas for how to set things up and how the whole operation could run better, beyond executing tasks

• Experience documenting processes as SOPs

• Minimum of 3 years of property accounting experience, college educated, fluent English



Nice to have (we'll train)



• CAM reconciliations and NNN retail accounting

• Corporate bookkeeping for the management company itself



How you'll work



• Fully remote, with working hours that overlap U.S. Central Time

• Dedicated to one client. You won't split your time across accounts

• Engaged through Scale Partner, the employer of record, which places you, onboards you and supports you after placement



Hiring process



1. Resume review

2. 90 Second video

3. First-round interview with Scale Partner, including technical questions on AppFolio, trust accounting and the monthly close

4. Interview with the client's leadership

5. Offer



If you've read this far and this sounds like you start your application with the word TRUST to be considered first.

title: Lead Airbnb Co-Host & VA Team Manager
description:
The Problem We Need Solved



We run a growing short-term rental business with 18+ units across the East Coast. For our guests, the experience starts the moment they hit “send” on their first message. We’ve outgrown our current setup:



- Guests need fast replies that sound warm and human, not like a copy-paste AI script.

- When something goes wrong, someone has to stay calm, think fast, and fix it before it turns into a bad review.

- Our VA team is talented but needs a leader to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

- Our systems and SOPs need an owner who improves them, not just someone who follows them.



That’s where you come in. We’re not hiring a “virtual assistant.” We’re hiring a right-hand operator: a Co-Host who treats our guests like their own and our business like they have skin in the game.



Speed Is Everything Here



We’ll be direct: this role is built around fast, clear communication. A guest who is locked out doesn’t want a reply in 20 minutes. They want one in 2, and they want it to solve the problem. You need to be someone who:



- Responds quickly, often within minutes, without giving up warmth or accuracy.

- Thinks on your feet. When there’s no SOP for what’s happening, you figure out a fix in the moment and act on it.

- Communicates clearly the first time, so guests, cleaners, and teammates don’t have to ask twice.

- Makes good calls under pressure, knowing when to handle something yourself and when to escalate.



If you need time to think everything through before acting, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re at your best when things are moving fast, keep reading.



Your Mission



You’ll be the voice our guests trust and the operator who keeps everything running behind the scenes. You’re the first person a guest hears from, and the last line of defense before a small hiccup becomes a one-star surprise.



What You’ll Do



- Own the full guest journey: inquiry, booking, check-in, mid-stay, and checkout. Every message is fast, warm, and human.

- Pick up the phone when a message won’t cut it, and resolve issues calmly in real time.

- Turn frustrated guests into 5-star reviews through sincere, thoughtful recovery.

- Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, inspectors, and property teams so every turnover is confirmed and guest-ready.

- Lead, train, and hold a small team of VAs accountable for consistent, high-quality communication.

- Build and refine SOPs for guest messaging, issue resolution, and daily operations so we get faster and tighter as we scale.

- Spot bottlenecks and bring us ideas on pricing, scheduling, and workflow.

- Handle light social media and admin tasks as needed.



Real Talk: The Heart of This Job



You’ll be on the phone with upset guests often. A booking went sideways, the door code won’t work, the unit isn’t what they pictured, and you’re the calm, confident, and clear voice on the other end. If calls with frustrated people wear you down, this isn’t the role for you. If you enjoy turning tension into gratitude and finding the fix nobody else saw, you’ll love it.



This Role Is Perfect for Someone Who…



- Can take a guest saying “the AC won’t turn on” and still earn a five-star review.

- Reads the emotion behind a message and knows right away whether to type or call.

- Gets a rush from closing out a tense situation with one calm, kind reply.

- Treats a clean inbox and a fully confirmed turnover calendar as a personal win.

- Leads a team the way they’d want to be led: clear, kind, and accountable.

- Always asks, “What else can I solve before anyone has to ask?”



What You Bring



- Hands-on short-term rental experience (Airbnb).

- Fast, clear communication, written and spoken. You can write a polished, friendly reply in under two minutes and explain -things simply on a call.

- Excellent English with clear, easy-to-understand speech. You’ll be on live calls with US guests daily, and they should never have to strain to understand you. This is non-negotiable.

- Real phone confidence. Calls with upset guests are a daily part of the job, not an exception.

- Proven de-escalation and creative problem-solving. You can turn furious into grateful and improvise when there’s no playbook.

- Leadership experience running a small (virtual) team.

- Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented.

- Comfortable with hospitality tech: PMS and messaging tools, calendars, Slack, WhatsApp, Hospitable, Guesty, and similar.

- High emotional intelligence, real warmth, and a genuine passion for hospitality.



Your Setup and Availability



- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, a second monitor, and a noise-canceling headset.

- Available US Eastern daytime hours, 7 days a week. Guest issues don’t keep office hours, and we need consistent coverage.



Compensation & Growth



- Competitive monthly salary based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to review scores and guest satisfaction.

- A long-term position with a real path into Operations Lead or Regional roles as we grow. You won’t just follow our standards; you’ll help shape them.



How We Hire



We don’t hire off a resume. We hire off mindset.



- How do you take feedback? We love people who grow from clear, kind communication.

- How do you make decisions? You’ll act independently and quickly, but always with care.

- What’s your default mode? Our favorite people ask, “What else can I own here?”



To Apply



Send both of the following. Applications missing either one won’t be considered.



- Your resume or CV.

- A 1–2 minute English introduction video introducing yourself and explaining why this role is the one for you.



Tip: We pay close attention to how quickly and clearly you respond during the hiring process. Treat it like a preview of the job.

You should be able to learn new systems quickly and troubleshoot basic technical problems independently.



5. Strong Communication and Teamwork

6. Ability to Follow Processes



We have established systems and workflows.  We're looking for someone who can follow detailed instructions consistently while also using good judgment when something doesn't look right.



Requirements



- Experience using Canva to create social media content

- Proficiency with Google Drive, Google Docs, and Google Sheets

- Excellent written English communication skills

title: Senior GoHighLevel Funnel & Marketing Automation Expert (Full Time)
description:
ABOUT US

The Nonprofit Guy helps nonprofit founders and executives start, fund, and grow their organizations through coaching, done-for-you services, and an online academy. We run weekly webinars, major virtual events, memberships, and high-ticket offers, and GoHighLevel is the engine behind all of it. We need a true GHL expert to own our system, raise our event show rates, and partner with our media buyer to drive growth.



This is a fast-paced role. Priorities shift, launches overlap, and deadlines are real. If you thrive on speed and still never drop a detail, this is for you.



SCHEDULE

Full time, 40 hours per week. Must overlap at least 4 hours with US Eastern Time.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Funnel Design

- Design high-converting, modern, mobile-first funnels: webinar registration, sales pages, opt-ins, application funnels, and thank-you pages

- Build from scratch, not just templates, with a strong eye for layout, typography, spacing, and brand consistency

- A/B test pages and improve conversion rates



Weekly Webinars and Major Events

- Update our weekly webinar funnel every week: new dates, titles, speakers, and reminder sequences

- Build and launch funnels for major events and summits: registration, ticketing, VIP upsells, reminders, and post-event follow-up

- Meet hard deadlines. Event funnels must be live, tested, and tracking correctly before ads go on



Show Rate Optimization

- Own and improve show rates for weekly webinars and virtual events

- Build multi-touch reminder sequences across drops (confirmation, 24 hours, 1 hour, 15 minutes, and "we're live now")

- Add calendar invites, add-to-calendar links, and value-driven reminders

- Track registrant-to-attendee rates weekly and test new tactics to raise them



Meta Ads Collaboration

- Work directly with our media buyer to launch and support Meta ad campaigns

- Build ad-specific landing pages that match funnel messaging to the ad creative

- Set up and verify Meta Pixel and Conversions API tracking inside GHL funnels

- Set up UTM tracking and attribution so we know which ads drive registrations and sales

- Sync GHL lists for retargeting and lookalike audiences

- Share weekly funnel data (opt-in rate, show rate, cost per registrant) with the media buyer



Automations and Workflows

- Build and maintain complex workflows: lead nurture, webinar reminders and no-show follow-up, onboarding, payment and failed-payment flows, and re-engagement

- Use if/else branching, wait steps, goal events, triggers, webhooks, and custom values

- Troubleshoot broken automations independently



Zapier and Integrations

- Build and maintain Zapier automations connecting GHL to our other tools (webinar platforms, payment processors, Google Sheets, Slack, and more)

- Troubleshoot failed Zaps and broken integrations quickly



Payment Processors

- Connect and manage multiple payment processors in GHL

- Set up order forms, payment plans, upsells, and order bumps

- Build failed-payment recovery workflows and make sure every purchase triggers the right access and onboarding



GHL AI Features

- Set up and train Conversation AI for chat and SMS support

- Configure Voice AI and AI agents where useful

- Use Content AI and Workflow AI to speed up builds and copy



Contact List Management

title: Social Media Image Post Creator – Viral News, Feel-Good, Gaming & More
description:
We run a network of large US entertainment and news pages on
 and Instagram with millions of followers across many niches. We're hiring several content creators to produce ready-to-post image posts using our in-house tools. The work is fully remote, you set your own hours, and you're paid for every approved post. If you're hungry and can produce quality at volume, you'll grow with us into higher rates, more pages and senior roles.



NICHES WE'RE HIRING FOR (pick the ones you know best)

- Viral & trending news: wild, unusual, "you won't believe this" real stories

- Feel-good & wholesome: kindness, everyday heroes, uplifting real-life moments

- Gaming: game news, drops, updates and gamer culture

- Relationships & dating: couples humor, dating drama, relatable relationship moments

- Women's humor & mom life: funny, relatable content for millennial women

- Weird news & internet stories: strange, funny, only-on-the-internet stories

- Animals: funny and heartwarming pet and rescue stories

- Nostalgia: 90s and 2000s throwbacks



WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Find stories. Pick real stories from our story feed and competitor feed that get people talking: unusual, funny, heartwarming, or "imagine being that guy." Never fake, satire or made-up news.

2. Build image posts in our tool:

   - Choose strong, clear photos, upscaling grainy ones if needed.

   - Use a 4:5 layout with people filling the top half above the headline.

   - Write a short, punchy headline.

   - Place the logo so it never covers faces or key details.

3. Write captions in each page's brand voice: deadpan and witty, a funny female voice, a laid-back bro voice, or uplifting with real humor. We'll train you on each one.

4. Schedule ahead. Everything is queued at least 2 days out, so a Friday batch covers through Monday.

5. Avoid flags. Follow our list of words and topics that risk platform penalties.



PAY

- $0.25 per approved image post to start

- Paid weekly. Posts that don't meet the standard are returned for a fix, not paid.

- Rate increases, bonuses, more pages and a path to team lead for top performers. Everyone starts at the base rate and earns their way up.



DAILY MINIMUMS ONCE TRAINED

- 30–40 image posts per day across your assigned pages, with at least 10 per page

- You'll start on 1–2 pages in your niche and grow from there.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent written English and a strong feel for US internet culture, memes and humor

- Experience with Canva or similar image tools, and with social media scheduling

- Detail-oriented and reliable: you hit your daily numbers without being reminded

- Reliable internet; phone-friendly work is a plus



HOW TO APPLY (applications close Tuesday, 11:59 PM Philippine time)

- Make the first word of your application PINEAPPLE so we know you read this.

- Tell us your top 2 niches from the list above, and why you know them well.

- Include 3 headlines you'd write for real stories from this week in your niche, with the story links.

- Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial on Wednesday covering image builds, captions and spotting risky content. Selected creators start Thursday.
salary: $0.25 per approved image post, paid week

As we continue to scale, we are seeking a highly experienced Accounting Manager to lead accounting operations, oversee multi-entity financial management, and build scalable financial infrastructure to support continued growth.

The Role

This role requires strong knowledge of US GAAP, multi-entity accounting, inter-company transactions, and consolidated reporting.. You will work directly with executive leadership to ensure financial accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency.

Financial Leadership & Close Management

title: Cold Calling Virtual Assistant
description:
Cold Caller

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

We are looking for a reliable and conversational cold caller to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls daily, following a basic process and script, and consistently completing daily outreach tasks. This is an entry-level position that is eligible for growth.





About Us



Started in 2017 and we're growing like crazy.

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2025 and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2026.

A small team of 1 American and 10 Filipinos.

We sell manual transmission driving lessons in the United States. Yes, really.

100% inbound leads from Organic Search (SEO).

No competition - in 90% of the markets we serve, we have no competitors. Because of this, our sales are pretty easy to make.





Compensation and Benefits

Compensation:

$4 per hour

Benefits to be provided after completion of 3 months:

Health Insurance



Type of Employment

Full/Part Time

40 hours per week

Schedule - 9 AM to 5 PM EST





Entry Level Details

Note that this is an entry-level job.

We do NOT expect you to have any prior sales experience.

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you.

We will train you on how to take customers through the sales process.

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Cold Caller, Remote Cold Caller, Cold Caller / Appointment Setter, B2B Cold Caller, Outbound Sales Representative, Outbound Appointment Setter, Sales Appointment Setter, Telemarketing Representative, Telesales Representative, Lead Generation Specialist, Sales Development Representative, SDR, Business Development Representative, BDR, Outbound Call Center Agent, Virtual Assistant – Cold Calling, Phone Sales Representative





Duties and Responsibilities

Make a high volume of outbound calls each day to businesses.

Follow call scripts, workflows, and basic procedures.

Log call outcomes and notes accurately.

Send follow-up
s and text messages when necessary.

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINKELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Identify decision-makers and schedule callbacks or appointments.

Communicate feedback and common objections to the team.



Requirements

Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, or a similar outbound sales role.

Experience making a large number of calls daily.

Ability to follow a defined process and use scripts effectively.

Strong conversational and listening skills.

Comfortable handling rejection and maintaining a positive attitude.

Excellent spoken English and clear communication skills.

Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience calling businesses or working in B2B sales.

Familiarity with CRMs and dialing software.

Experience working remotely.







What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINKELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. title: Executive Support Specialist — California Insurance Experience Required
description:

/bepartofourteam.



About

The Role

The Mindset We're Looking For



The best Executive Support Specialists we've worked with share a few traits:



They figure things out. When something comes up they haven't seen before, they don't freeze — they think it through, find a path forward, and get it done.

They don't wait to be told. If something needs to happen, they handle it — then let you know it's done, not ask for permission first.

They're honest when things go wrong. Mistakes happen. What matters is that they surface it immediately, own it, and fix it — not hope no one notices.

They're naturally curious. They ask questions other people don't think to ask. They pick up new tools and processes quickly because they actually want to understand how things work.

They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What stays in the business stays in the business — no exceptions.

They use AI like a professional tool. Not a novelty. Something they rely on daily to do better work faster.



Who Thrives Here



People who are quietly excellent. You don't need recognition for every task — you find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even when no one notices the work behind it.



We're a growing business, which means priorities shift and not everything is perfectly documented yet. If you're the type who takes initiative and figures things out without waiting for a perfect playbook — you'll do well here.



What You'll Do



You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.



That looks like:



Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines — this is the core of the role

Managing inbound communication across
 and phone — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs attention

What We're Looking For

Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, easy to listen to; clients always feel heard

Proven experience in a support, virtual assistant, or administrative role

Active, confident daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent)

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Strong written English —
s are clear and professional before they're sent

High attention to detail — errors get caught before they leave your desk

Strong organizational skills — multiple priorities, nothing slips

Self-directed once you're up to speed — asks the right questions early, works independently after

Experience with insurance agency management systems (Applied Epic, AMS360, Hawksoft, or equivalent)

Experience with automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent)

Familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, or similar project management tools

Basic bookkeeping experience (QuickBooks or Xero)



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new team members.



In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand how things operate, our tools, our standards, and how information flows across the business. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape how they support clients and manage their work.



We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At three months:

Renewals and account servicing are running without dropped deadlines or missed follow-ups. Communication is handled, and you're already using AI tools to produce outputs faster than expected.



At six months:

You're anticipating needs before they're voiced. Repetitive tasks have been automated or streamlined. The work is running more smoothly because of systems and habits you built — without being asked.



At twelve months:

You're an indispensable part of how the business operates. Trust is solid. The work you've done — the systems, the habits, the consistency — would be immediately felt if it disappeared. 
 is investing in what's next for you.



How We Work



You won't be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We're a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:

You need constant check-ins and direction to stay on track

You let things slip and wait for someone else to catch it

You'd stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation

Confidentiality feels optional depending on the situation

You've never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don't plan to start

Shifting priorities and imperfect systems frustrate rather than motivate you



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.

HMO
