title: B2B Lead Generation Specialist. Cold caller/Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated B2B Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to help generate new business opportunities for a U.S.-based telecommunications Account Executive which is T-Mobile



The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume outbound calls, researching businesses, speaking with owners and decision-makers, handling objections, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments.



This is a performance-driven sales position. Your success will be measured by the number and quality of qualified appointments you generate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation



* Research and identify small and mid-sized businesses.

* Build targeted prospect lists using Google Maps, Google Search, business directories, LinkedIn, and other sources.

* Identify the business owner, manager, office manager, or person responsible for wireless/telecommunications.

* Find business phone numbers and available contact information.

* Prioritize businesses that are likely to have multiple employees, company phones, tablets, hotspots, or fleet vehicles.



2. Cold Calling



* Make outbound B2B calls to business prospects.

* Introduce our telecommunications solutions professionally.

* Quickly identify whether the business is a potential fit.

* Ask discovery questions about their current wireless provider, number of lines, monthly spending, and pain points.

* Handle common objections professionally.

* Generate interest without being overly aggressive.



3. Appointment Setting



* Book qualified appointments directly on the Account Executive’s calendar.

* Confirm the appointment with the prospect.

* Send follow-up messages when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate appointment notes.

* Make sure appointments meet the agreed qualification criteria.



4. Follow-Up



* Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready to speak immediately.

* Re-contact previous leads.

* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.

* Track conversations and outcomes in the CRM/spreadsheet.



5. Sales Intelligence

The VA should identify opportunities such as:



* Businesses with 5+ employees

* Multiple business phone lines

* Companies with fleet vehicles

* Construction companies

* HVAC companies

* Plumbing companies

* Electrical contractors

* Landscaping companies

* Pest control companies

* Roofing companies

* Delivery/courier companies

* Property management companies

* Medical/dental offices

* Professional-service businesses

* Salons/barbershops

* Other businesses likely to have multiple wireless users



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has B2B cold-calling experience

* Has appointment-setting experience

* Has strong spoken English

* Sounds confident and professional on the phone

* Is comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls per day

* Can handle rejection without becoming discouraged

* Understands basic sales psychology

* Can identify decision-makers

* Can overcome common objections

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Can work independently

* Has reliable internet and a quiet workspace

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and communication tools

* Is highly motivated by performance and results



Performance Expectations



Daily targets:



* 50–100+ outbound calls

* 20+ meaningful conversations when possible

* 10–20+ newly researched prospects

* Consistent follow-up on previous prospects

* Accurate CRM/spreadsheet updates



Primary KPI:

Qualified appointments booked



Quality is more important than simply booking appointments. Appointments should ideally be with a business owner or decision-maker who has a legitimate need for business wireless services.



Qualification Questions



The VA should learn to determine:



1. Who is currently providing your business wireless service?

2. Approximately how many business lines do you have?

3. Are those lines company-owned or employee-owned?

4. Roughly how much does the business spend on wireless each month?

5. Are you currently under contract?

6. Are you experiencing any issues with your current provider?

7. Who makes the final decision regarding your wireless service?

8. When would you be open to reviewing another option?



The goal is not to hard-sell on the first call. The goal is to determine whether there is an opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto the Account Executive’s calendar.





If you’ve made it this far and read the role qualifications. Please send a virtual video of introducing yourself and why you are the best fit for this role.

title: REMOTE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR
description:
REMOTE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR



Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Position



ABOUT THE POSITION



Hunt Glass is a growing mobile auto glass company looking for an exceptionally organized, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to help keep our office and daily operations running smoothly.



This is NOT simply a data-entry position.



We are looking for someone who loves organization, notices small details, follows through without needing constant reminders, and takes pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You will work closely with our office team to coordinate jobs from the time they are sold until they are successfully completed.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Order windshields, auto glass, and related parts from suppliers



• Verify vehicle, customer, and job information before orders are placed



• Schedule and coordinate installation appointments



• Communicate with customers by text,
, and phone



• Send appointment confirmations and reminders



• Coordinate schedules and job information with technicians



• Track open jobs and make sure each one moves toward completion



• Follow up on incomplete jobs, outstanding orders, and unresolved issues



• Keep customer and job records accurate and organized



• Catch scheduling conflicts, missing information, and potential problems before they become bigger problems



• Help develop and improve office systems, checklists, and procedures



• Perform other administrative and operations tasks as the company grows



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if you:



• Are exceptionally organized



• Have excellent attention to detail



• Have strong written and spoken English



• Are comfortable learning new computer systems



• Can manage many tasks and priorities at the same time



• Are dependable and consistent



• Take initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do



• Are comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right



• Enjoy creating order out of complicated situations



• Can work independently with minimal supervision



• Take ownership of your responsibilities and follow tasks through to completion



EXPERIENCE THAT IS HELPFUL, BUT NOT REQUIRED



• Operations coordination



• Dispatching or logistics



• Administrative or executive assistant work



• Customer service



• Scheduling



• CRM software



• Automotive industry experience



• Auto glass experience



WHAT MATTERS MOST TO US



Auto glass experience is NOT required.



We can teach you our industry and our processes.



What is much harder to teach is exceptional organization, good judgment, attention to detail, reliability, and the ability to solve problems.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of our team as the company grows.



COMPENSATION



Starting compensation: $3.00 USD per hour during the initial training period.



Raises are available as you demonstrate accuracy, reliability, independence, and increased responsibility.



There is significant opportunity for growth for the right person.



SCHEDULE



Full-time position.



Because you will be coordinating with our U.S.-based team, technicians, suppliers, and customers, you must be willing and able to work the required U.S. business hours.



Specific working hours will be discussed during the interview process.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.



2. A description of your previous work experience.



3. Tell us why you believe you are an exceptionally organized person.



4. Give us a specific example of a time you had several important things that needed to be completed at the same time. Explain how you d
 what to do first.



5. Tell us about a mistake you caught before it became a larger problem.



6. Describe a system, checklist, spreadsheet, or process you have created or improved.



7. Tell us your current availability and whether you are able to work U.S. business hours.



8. Tell us your desired hourly compensation after you have completed training and demonstrated that you can perform the position independently.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION:



At the very beginning of your application, write the words:



"CLEARLY AHEAD"



Then tell us, in ONE sentence, what you believe is the single most important quality for someone responsible for coordinating many customer jobs at the same time.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



HIRING PROCESS



Candidates who perform well on the initial application will be invited to complete a short skills assessment.



The assessment will test organization, attention to detail, prioritization, problem-solving, and written communication.



Finalists may also be invited to complete a short paid practical exercise.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and growing with Hunt Glass.

title: WordPress Developer (Elementor / ACF) – Start Immediately
description:
About the role



We're a Canadian branding and web agency with a small remote team. We need a second WordPress developer to support our lead developer, who currently has more assignments than hours. This is a junior to mid-level role. You will not be making design or strategy decisions. You will be receiving clear, written task briefs and executing them accurately and on time.



Workload varies week to week. Some weeks will be 10 hours, some will be 30. You need to be reliable and responsive when work comes in.



What you'll do



Build new pages in WordPress from Figma files or mockups, matching the design accurately (spacing, fonts, colours, responsive behaviour). Make edits to existing pages and blog posts from written instructions: copy changes, image swaps, layout fixes, new sections. Work in Elementor Pro and on ACF-driven pages. Enter SEO metadata into Rank Math Pro exactly as written in the brief. Upload and format images to spec. Add provided HTML and CSS snippets via WPCode. Fix responsive and cross-browser issues. Occasionally help basic reporting if you have the skills.



Must have



At least one year of hands-on WordPress experience. Comfortable in Elementor Pro and the WordPress admin. Able to read a Figma file or mockup and build the page to match. Basic HTML and CSS. Able to follow step-by-step written instructions exactly, without skipping steps or improvising. Good written English. Reliable internet and availability to respond on Microsoft Teams during North American business hours for at least part of your day. Able to start this week.



Nice to have (not required)



ACF (Advanced Custom Fields). Rank Math or other SEO plugin experience. Cloudways or similar managed hosting. PHP or JavaScript. Metricool or social media scheduling tools. Social media reporting. Canva or basic graphic design.



How we work



Every task comes with a written brief. You give a written hour estimate before you start any task. You log your time daily. You do not take on tasks that haven't been assigned to you. You ask questions on Teams if a brief is unclear rather than guessing. Rework caused by not following the brief is not paid.



To apply



Reply with the subject line "WP Dev – [Your Name]" and include: a link to 2–3 WordPress sites you've built or edited, stating what you did on each; at least one example of a page you built from a Figma file or mockup; your years of experience with Elementor and WordPress; your available hours per week and your timezone; confirmation you can start immediately at $6 CAD per hour. Applications without site links will not be considered.

title: Senior Media Buyer
description:
Company Overview:

Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading ecommerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialise in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience. We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and are committed to the creation of products that enhance the lives of our consumers.



Mission of the Role:

The mission of this role is to drive profitable e-commerce growth by executing and optimizing high-performing media buys across platforms, responsibly managing four-figure daily budgets to hit target ROAS while maintaining a great user experience (including weekend performance reviews). This role goes beyond adjusting budgets and switching ads on or off. You’ll help find customer angles, shape creative tests, and give specific feedback to our copywriting and creative teams. You’ll be accountable for the performance of your projects while working with the Media Buying Lead on priorities and broader strategy.



This role starts off as a 6-month contract role, with the possibility of conversion to a permanent position subject to individual performance and business needs.



Key Responsibilities:

- Own direct response projects on Meta. Plan, launch, manage, and scale campaigns for assigned products or offers, with clear targets for acquisition and profitability.

- Turn data into decisions. Monitor spend, revenue, ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, average order value, and other relevant funnel metrics. Diagnose performance changes and propose actions based on the evidence.

- Build a testing plan. Develop hypotheses, prioritise tests, define what success looks like, and use the results to d
 what to scale, revise, or stop.

- Find angles and guide creative development. Research customers, competitors, and market trends to identify fresh angles and hooks. Brief copywriters and designers, then give practical feedback on ad copy, images, and videos using performance data and your understanding of the audience.

- Manage budgets responsibly and optimise for ROI. Allocate spend across campaigns and tests, respond to performance changes, and scale what works while meeting profitability and return on investment (ROI) targets. 

- Work across the customer journey. Look beyond ad metrics to identify issues with landing pages, offers, checkout, tracking, or attribution, and work with the relevant teams to resolve them.

- Communicate clearly. Share concise performance updates, explain what you’ve learned, and recommend the next actions for each project.

- Maintain campaign quality. Follow Meta advertising policies, ensure ads provide a positive user experience, and review live campaigns regularly, including weekend performance checks when required. 

- Handle any other ad-hoc projects or tasks as assigned.



Key Requirements:

- Degree or higher (preferably in business/marketing or a related field) with 2 years of experience running marketing campaigns for e-commerce stores to generate revenue.

- Strong proven knowledge of media-buying platforms and its compliance/guidelines such as
, Bing, and Google Ads.

- At least 2 years and 1 year of hands-on experience managing
 Ads and Google Ads respectively.

- Analytical mindset and a self-starter with the ability to develop solutions and next steps for campaign testing.

- Positive and can-do attitude when handling new marketing campaigns that require rigorous testing.

- Sense of ownership in one’s performance and its impact on company’s success which includes responsibly managing a 4-figure media buying daily budget and achieving the target ROAS.

- Conversant in English and possess a creative mindset which will be useful for creating and writing advertising assets in the form of copy, video, and images that suit the target audience.

- Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, explore customer angles, develop testing ideas, and analyse campaign results, while checking outputs against actual performance data and advertising guidelines. 



Key Technical Skills:

- Excellent understanding of
 Platforms

- Skills and experience with programs such as Canva and Photoshop are advantageous.

- Good understanding of media analytics tools such as Google Analytics UA & GA4.

- Familiarity with other tracking platforms such as Voluum, Hyros, Redtrack is a bonus.

-Experience with Microsoft Tools



Remote Working Setup

- A computer with suitable performance.

- At least two monitor screens, including the laptop screen.

- A noise-cancelling headset with microphone and a webcam.

- A designated workstation in a quiet, conducive environment.

- Reliable power and internet connectivity.



The Ideal Candidate

You’re a hands-on media buyer who enjoys the challenge of growing sales profitably. You’ve managed e-commerce campaigns on Meta, know how to make decisions when performance changes, and are comfortable being accountable for a four-figure daily budget. You can explain what the numbers are telling you, what you’ll test next, and when it makes sense to scale or pull back.



You bring more than platform expertise. You’re curious about customers, offers, and the reasons people buy. You can spot promising angles, brief copywriters and designers clearly, and use campaign results to make creative feedback more specific. When an ad performs poorly, you look across the full customer journey before d
 what needs to change.



You take ownership of your projects, communicate your thinking concisely, and stay attentive to live campaign performance, including weekend checks when needed.

**Client Dispute Manager (CDM) Dispute Specialist — Remote Contractor**



We are a Minnesota-based credit restoration company seeking an experienced contractor to process consumer dispute files in Client Dispute Manager (CDM) and conduct a limited number of scheduled client update calls. We need someone who already knows CDM, reviews three-bureau reports carefully, communicates clearly, and maintains accurate records.



**Responsibilities**



* Import or review current reports in CDM and compare them with prior results.

* Identify potentially inaccurate or incomplete reporting and prepare individualized dispute letters following our approved procedures.

* Upload and organize supporting documents and letters, maintain clear CDM notes, and save a progress or status report in the designated client folder.

* Track dispute rounds, promptly flag missing information or report-import errors, and identify files that need management review.

* Hand completed files to the team member responsible for mailing, clearly noting anything still outstanding.

* Conduct a limited number of scheduled client update calls each week. Review the file before calling, explain the work completed and the next steps, document the conversation in CDM, and escalate questions outside our approved procedures.



We expect to build toward approximately **50 assigned client files per week** once the workflow is established. Our target is to complete each file that has all required reports, access, and documents **within one business day of assignment**. We will begin with a paid trial batch and increase volume after confirming accuracy and capacity.



**Requirements**



* Hands-on CDM experience with report imports, dispute rounds, letters, uploads, and notes.

* Understanding of Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion reports, collections, charge-offs, late payments, and dispute follow-up.

* Strong written and spoken English and a professional manner on client calls.

* Careful documentation, reliable communication, and appropriate handling of confidential client information.

* Ability to follow a documented workflow, flag exceptions promptly, and correct errors.



Experience researching collections or coordinating settlements is a plus. Settlement work is not part of the standard per-file assignment and would be discussed separately.



**Compensation:** Proposed **$10–$15 per completed client file/dispute round**, depending on experience and the agreed scope. One file means one assigned client and one specified dispute round; the number of letters may vary. Scheduled client calls will be compensated separately. We will agree on the completion checklist and payment terms before work begins. This is a contractor role.



**To apply, please answer:**



1. How long have you used CDM? Describe your workflow from report import through letters, notes, and folder organization.

2. How many client files or dispute rounds can you accurately complete in a week? What could prevent a one-business-day turnaround?

3. Describe a reporting discrepancy you caught that a template letter might have missed. Do not share client-identifying information.

4. What per-file rate do you propose for the work described above? Are you available for a paid trial batch?

5. Describe your experience giving clients phone updates. Are you available for scheduled calls during U.S. Central business hours?

6. Do you have experience researching collections or documenting settlement offers?



The paid trial will use fictional or fully de-identified material. Please do not include real client reports, account numbers, credentials, or personal information in your application.

Practice Marketing Project Manager (PH)

The Role

We're looking for a Practice Marketing Project Manager to give our Practice Marketing team the project management muscle it needs to grow. Right now, the team's own bandwidth is the ceiling on how many accounts we can service well — this role raises that ceiling.



You'll keep our top accounts on track, hold timelines and deliverables accountable, and free up our Practice Marketing Managers to spend their time on strategy and client relationships instead of chasing tasks. You'll also be stepping into the role of process-builder for the department — the systems and templates you create won't just serve today's accounts, they'll become the backbone the team scales on as Moxie takes on more clients.



This is a foundational hire for the team: half the job is running today's accounts cleanly, and half is building the infrastructure that lets Practice Marketing grow without sacrificing quality.





Our Objectives for the Role

- Bring full visibility to our top accounts by standing up a project tracking system and owning status reporting, so timelines, deliverables, and owners are always clear — without a manager needing to chase for updates

- Build and roll out a standardized project plan template that every new account runs on, so onboarding and delivery are consistent across the whole department

- Grow into a trusted operator who brings data-backed recommendations to leadership and takes on a piece of account load independently — positioning this role for growth into a Senior Project Manager or team lead track

- If things go even better than expected, you become the reason our top accounts run without fire drills — and the model we point to as we open new markets and bring on new clients.





We're Looking For

- A systems builder, not just a tracker. You don't just maintain a project tracker — you've built one from scratch, templated a process, or standardized a workflow that other people then adopted.

- Comfort owning accountability without owning the relationship. You can hold timelines and deliverables firm with marketing managers and clients without being the strategic or client-facing lead yourself.

- A bias toward visibility. You default to making status, risk, and ownership obvious to everyone — not just tracked in your own head or inbox.

- Judgment on when to flag versus when to solve. You can tell the difference between a risk that needs to be escalated now and one you can quietly resolve yourself.

- Early-career hunger for ownership. You want a role that stretches past "coordinate the calendar" and are motivated by building something that outlasts you.





Why Join Us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- A clear growth path from Project Manager into a leadership track, with clear metrics to show your progress along the way.

- Competitive salary

title: Paid Media Creative Specialist (PH)
description:
!!! READ ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING !!!



PH - Paid Media Creative Specialist



We're looking for a PH - Marketing Creative Specialist to own the creative outcomes for paid social campaigns — concepts, iterations, and final static and video deliverables — directly driving the metrics (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) that determine campaign performance, while also making ads that are beautiful and delight our clients.



You'll also be stepping into building and owning AI-augmented creative workflows — using AI as leverage to increase the volume and quality of what you ship, without letting it replace your own trend instincts and creative judgment.



We’re looking for a creative who loves Meta - who lives and breathes Instagram. And who is obsessed with what makes content convert - both organically and in paid ads. You’ll get the autonomy and creative freedom to make amazing designs - and the responsibility for how those perform, and more importantly, using how they perform to improve what we make next. Done well, you’ll help us build creative capability that not just delights our clients, but delivers on ROI and growth.



Our objectives for the role

- Ship creatives that delight our practices: creatives that highlight what’s best about their practices, results, and branding – and that they’re so excited about that they regularly ask us if they can post our ads as organic content on their feeds, too.

- Own creative performance (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) across your designs – and turn patterns of performance into meaningful insights and repeatable elements or frameworks that get actioned in feedback loops into your work and the broader team.

- Spot trends and micro-trends and translate them into on-brand, executable static and video creatives – that appeal to the right audiences and pain points for a given campaign.

- Demonstrate command of production tools, specs, file setup, and platform requirements across Meta placements, and become a go-to resource on specs and complex production issues (compression, accessibility, delivery).

- Contribute to AI-driven creative workflows and frameworks — for concepting, production, or testing — that get adopted across the broader creative team.

- Scale a creative process or workflow into standard team practice, and act as a subject-matter expert whose creative-performance patterns guide the rest of the team.



We're looking for:

- Top Tier Aesthetic Taste — you know the exact layouts, fonts, music, and styling that will make creative pop. You can design for multiple aesthetics and never ship a boring or basic creative.

- Creative ownership and execution — you can spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work across both static and video, within provided frameworks, not just execute someone else's brief. This includes writing the copy and executing the design work, on-brand, and owning its performance in the ad platforms.

- Performance fluency — you're fluent in performance creative and think in terms of the metrics that matter: CTR, hook rate, cost per result, and ultimately, ROI.

- Turn Patterns into Systems — you see the hook that performs in every video ad you ship as a repeatable element you should mix into every new video we script, and that one red button that always makes a graphic’s cost per lead lower as your ace in your back pocket for accounts whose creative just doesn’t hit. And you’re ready to take this skill further into templates that de-risk creative performance, using insights from across a portfolio of brands running similar ads.

- Production mastery — deep command of specs, file setup,editing/creating tools (including AI augmentation), and platform requirements, with the ability to independently resolve production issues that stump others.

- Trend fluency — you already think like a trend-setter; spotting what's next is a skill you own, not something you outsource to an algorithm.

- Productive use of AI — you build and own AI-augmented workflows, using AI as leverage rather than a crutch or a replacement for your judgment. Ads and creatives that are obviously AI give you the ick - and you would never give us a final product that looks like Claude, or Chat, or some other AI tool’s basic output - even though you probably did use them to help you execute it.



Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- This role is built for a creative who wants real ownership — not just execution against someone else's brief, but the ability to spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work, across both static and video.

- It's a high-autonomy, high-trust role with a clear growth path toward creative leadership, working at the frontier of AI-augmented creative production without being replaced by it.

- Competitive salary

title: Media Buyer Specialist (PH)
description:
!!! PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING !!!



PH - Media Buyer Specialist



We're looking for a Media Buyer Specialist to own the performance and impact of a large book of complex, custom paid media campaigns for our practices — leading strategy, setup, optimization, and communication with practices and cross-functional teams to get results.



You'll also be stepping into using AI as leverage — scaling both the quality and volume of your work by recognizing patterns, making good bets, and playing to exploit every advantage, rather than relying on automated platforms or SOPs to do the thinking for you.



Ad buying is changing fast. This role exists for someone who understands data, tracking, and the full funnel deeply enough to know when to follow our best practices and when to trust their own judgment — and who's ready to own the outcome either way. Getting this right lets the rest of our media team focus on their own work instead of constantly course-correcting an underperforming book.



Our objectives for the role

- Own the performance of a large, complex book of campaigns, around 50 initially and scales up with time — from strategy and setup through optimization — and be accountable for the outcome, whether you followed our playbooks or your own judgment to get there.

- Build deep command of our reporting and tracking systems so you can pull your own data, diagnose account health quickly and accurately, and manage risk proactively before it shows up in results.

- Use AI as leverage to run more accounts at a higher level — treating media buying as a competitive game of pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven testing, and educated bets – to drive results you’ll own.

- Contribute best practices and workflows — like a new setup approach or AI-assisted process — that get adopted as standard team practice.

- Use your understanding of the full funnel we deploy and your excellent communication skills to influence clients and cross-functional teams towards better performance for the campaigns you own.



We're looking for:

- Ownership and accountability — you take full responsibility for a large book of accounts' results, regardless of whether you followed an SOP or your own judgment to get there.

- Autonomy and judgment — you know when to lean on established playbooks and when to deviate, and you're comfortable making that call independently.

- Optimization and testing rigor — you approach media buying like a competitive game: pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven tests, and educated bets, not guesswork.

- Tracking and reporting command — you can pull your own data and diagnose account and tracking health quickly, without waiting on someone else to hand you a report.

- Productive use of AI — you use AI to scale the volume and quality of your work, but you don't let it replace your own judgment on what actually moves the needle.



Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- This is a role built for media buyers who want to own outcomes, not just execute tickets — full autonomy over a book of accounts, real say in when to follow SOPs versus your own judgment, and credit for the results either way.

- It's an IC track with real influence: your work shapes team playbooks and best practices, without requiring you to manage people to get that influence.

- You'll work within a high-caliber team where iron sharpens iron — challenging, fast-paced, and genuinely fun if you like this game.

- Competitive salary

- Assist with marketing automation workflow setup and outbound cold outreach operations

- Test, execute, and scale outbound campaigns across direct mail, SMS, social DMs/forums, and cold email 



Success in This Role Looks Like:

- Consistent flow of high quality, qualified leads handed off to our loan officers

- Active presence in online investor communities, with leads coming in from outreach

- Clear prospecting strategies running across multiple channels

- Strong discovery conversations and borrower screening



What We Offer

- Competitive base pay

- Aggressive commission on every closed loan

- Full-time with growth potential

- Flexible U.S./PH holiday schedule

- Career path in private lending with deep industry mentorship

- A long-term role with an established, loyal team—we have 4+ PH hires with us for over 2+ years



How to Apply (No Resume-Only Submissions):

You MUST complete our application form and attach a 1–2 min voice intro explaining your experience in real estate lending and outbound lead generation -

title: AI GEO Manager
description:
AI SEO / GEO Manager

Location: Remote — Philippines preferred

Timezone: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–4:00 PM Eastern Time

Hours: Approximately 25 hours per week

Employment Type: Part-Time



About the Role

SAMA Labs is looking for an experienced AI SEO / GEO Manager to lead traditional SEO and AI search visibility initiatives across our growing portfolio of e-commerce brands.

You will own strategy, prioritize opportunities, manage implementation, and report on performance. This is a hands-on management role: you should be comfortable developing a brand’s optimization roadmap and completing the work needed to move it forward.

Your focus will be helping brands improve their organic search presence and become easier to discover, understand, mention, and cite across platforms such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Gemini, and Perplexity.

We are looking for someone with strong SEO fundamentals, practical AI SEO/GEO experience, and the judgment to distinguish useful optimization work from tactics that lack evidence.



Primary Responsibilities

SEO & AI Visibility Strategy

Build and manage SEO/GEO roadmaps for multiple e-commerce clients.

Establish baseline performance and identify each brand’s highest-priority opportunities.

Research relevant keywords, buying questions, conversational queries, and AI search prompts.

Analyze competitors’ organic visibility, AI mentions, cited content, and content gaps.

Translate findings into clear tasks, timelines, and measurable goals.

Balance technical improvements, content development, on-page optimization, and authority building.

Adjust priorities based on performance, business goals, and available resources.

AI SEO / GEO Management

Monitor how client brands and competitors appear across relevant AI search experiences.

Maintain a consistent set of prompts to track brand mentions, citations, and visibility over time.

Identify which pages and external sources AI platforms reference for relevant buying questions.

Improve product, collection, FAQ, and informational content so it clearly answers customer questions.

Strengthen consistency across brand information, product attributes, entities, and supporting content.

Identify opportunities for credible third-party coverage, relevant listings, and industry citations.

Review structured data, product information, and feeds for accuracy and completeness.

Evaluate crawler access and technical issues that may affect search discovery.

Test emerging approaches, document results, and recommend changes based on evidence.

You should understand that AI search results vary by platform, prompt, location, and timing. We expect thoughtful measurement and realistic recommendations.

Traditional SEO & On-Page Optimization



Own and oversee optimization across:



Product pages

Collection/category pages

Landing pages

Blog and educational content

Internal links and website navigation

Images and other indexable assets

Responsibilities include:

Keyword research and search intent mapping

Title tags and meta descriptions

Header hierarchy and page structure

Product and collection content

Descriptive image ALT text

Internal linking

Duplicate content and keyword cannibalization

Content refreshes and new content opportunities

You should be comfortable managing large product catalogs through repeatable processes while maintaining accuracy and brand consistency.

Technical SEO Oversight

Conduct website audits and prioritize issues affecting crawling, indexing, and organic performance.

Review redirects, broken links, canonical tags, XML sitemaps, and robots directives.

Identify issues involving duplicate URLs, collection filters, and product variants.

Review relevant schema markup for accuracy and eligibility.

Coordinate technical fixes with developers and verify completed work.

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing issues and changes in performance.



You do not need to be a full-stack developer, but you must be able to diagnose common SEO issues and provide clear implementation instructions.



Content Planning & Quality Control

Build content briefs around customer needs, search intent, product knowledge, and business priorities.

Guide writers, assistants, and other contributors when assigned.

Review content for accuracy, brand voice, readability, originality, and conversion potential.

Ensure product claims and specifications match approved source information.

Use AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, analysis, and production.

Fact-check and edit AI-assisted work before publication.

You are accountable for the quality of the final work, regardless of which tools produced the first draft.

Project Management & Reporting

Maintain clear task lists, ownership, deadlines, and progress updates across client accounts.

Create repeatable workflows and quality-control checklists.

Delegate execution tasks when support is available and review completed work.

Communicate priorities, blockers, findings, and next steps to the internal team.

Produce straightforward monthly reports that connect completed work to performance.



Reporting should include, where data is available:

AI SEO / GEO

Visibility score, with the measurement method clearly defined

Brand mentions

Cited pages and citations

Performance across monitored prompts

Identifiable AI referral traffic, conversions, and revenue

Traditional SEO

Organic traffic

Overall keyword visibility and ranking trends

Priority keyword performance

Organic conversions and revenue

Domain authority or similar third-party metrics as supporting indicators

Reports should explain what changed, what it means, and what we are doing next, including any measurement limitations.



What We’re Looking For

Required

Proven experience independently managing SEO campaigns or client accounts.

Practical experience with AI SEO, GEO, or answer-engine optimization.

Strong understanding of on-page, technical, semantic, and entity-based SEO.

Experience working with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

Ability to turn audits and research into prioritized implementation plans.

Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, and SEO research tools.

Familiarity with website crawling tools such as Screaming Frog.

Working knowledge of schema markup and structured data.

Strong written English and the ability to edit content critically.

Strong project management skills and attention to detail.

Confidence working with spreadsheets, large URL lists, and product catalogs.

Ability to evaluate AI-generated output and verify recommendations.

Reliable internet connection.



Consistent availability Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, adjusting for U.S. daylight saving time.



AI SEO / GEO Experience





You should be able to explain:

Which AI visibility projects you have worked on.

What you personally researched, implemented, or managed.

How you selected and monitored relevant prompts.

How you tracked mentions, citations, and visibility.

What results you observed and how you evaluated them.

Which findings were supported by evidence and which remained experimental.

Familiarity with AI terminology alone is not sufficient for this role.

Nice to Have

Experience managing SEO across multiple agency clients.

Experience leading assistants, writers, or contractors.

Experience with large Shopify product catalogs.

Familiarity with Semrush, Ahrefs, or dedicated AI visibility tools.

Experience with Google Merchant Center and product feeds.

Experience with digital PR, editorial outreach, or authority-building initiatives.

Familiarity with Google Tag Manager and attribution limitations.

Experience building efficient SEO workflows and automations.

WooCommerce experience.

What Success Looks Like

Success means delivering organized execution and measurable progress across client accounts.

You will be expected to:

Establish a reliable baseline for traditional SEO and AI visibility.

Create clear roadmaps aligned with each client’s goals.

Keep implementation moving consistently.

Maintain high standards across published content and technical changes.

Identify opportunities that support qualified traffic, product discovery, and conversions.

Explain results clearly and adjust strategy when the evidence calls for it.

We value sound judgment, accountability, and business impact alongside consistent execution.

What We Offer

Consistent part-time schedule of approximately 25 hours per week.

Fully remote position.

Long-term opportunity for the right person.

Ownership of SEO and AI visibility initiatives across multiple e-commerce brands.

Collaboration with our paid media, content, creative, and web teams.

Continued development in traditional SEO and emerging AI search.

Opportunity to help shape SAMA Labs’ SEO/GEO processes and service delivery.





How to Apply

Please send:

Your resume/CV.

A brief overview of your experience managing SEO strategy and implementation.

One or two examples of AI SEO/GEO projects, including your responsibilities, approach, tools, and results.

Details of your Shopify and e-commerce experience.

A sample audit, roadmap, or performance report, with confidential information removed.

Confirmation that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including daylight saving adjustments.



Please also answer these questions:

1. A Shopify brand has 500 product pages, limited non-branded organic traffic, and little visibility across relevant AI search prompts. What would you prioritize in the first 30, 60, and 90 days—and why?

2. How would you measure whether your AI SEO/GEO work is improving visibility? Explain what you would track, how you would maintain consistent comparisons, and any limitations you would communicate.

3. How would you organize and quality-check optimization across 500 product pages while coordinating work with an assistant, writer, or developer?

title: Inside Sales & Customer Experience Specialist – Major Appliances
description:
Full-time, remote | $1,200–$1,800 USD per month



VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY (see below)



About Park Ave Appliance



Park Ave Appliance is an online major-appliance retailer based in New Jersey, selling refrigerators, ranges, washers, dryers, dishwashers and other major appliances through 
.

These are important, high-ticket purchases. Customers often have questions before buying and sometimes need help after the order is placed.

We are looking for a very sharp, confident salesperson who can sell, think quickly, take ownership of customers, and solve problems without needing to be told every step.

The job

You will be one of the main people speaking with customers who shop on our website.

A large part of the job is sales: helping shoppers choose the right appliance, answering questions, comparing products, overcoming hesitation and closing the order.

But your responsibility does not end when the customer pays.

You will also help make sure orders go through properly and that customers are taken care of when something changes or goes wrong.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Speak with shoppers by phone, chat and
 and turn conversations into orders.

- Understand what the customer actually needs and help them choose the right product.

- Compare models and explain differences clearly without overwhelming the customer.

- Follow up with shoppers who asked questions or did not complete their purchase.

- Offer appropriate add-ons and upgrades, including installation, haul-away, protection plans and matching products.

- Review incoming website orders for pricing, availability, address information and delivery details.

- Contact customers quickly when an order needs attention.

- Handle backorders, delivery issues, product changes and other problems.

- Keep customers informed even when you do not yet have the final answer.

- Follow every customer issue until it is actually resolved.

- Communicate clearly with our team so everyone knows what is happening with an order.

- Handle several chats, calls and orders at the same time without dropping things.

- Learn our products and industry quickly.



Different customers need different types of conversations.

Some customers want every specification and want to compare several models. Others simply want you to tell them which washer or refrigerator is good and help them make a decision quickly.

A strong salesperson understands the person they are speaking with and adjusts accordingly.

This is not an order-entry job.

We need someone who thinks.

If you do not know an answer, figure out how to find it.

If something goes wrong with an order, take ownership of it.

If you are waiting for someone else, follow up.

If you see a problem, do not wait for somebody to tell you what to do.



Who we are looking for

- Strong experience in sales, customer service, or another customer-facing role.

- Experience selling by phone, chat or
.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Comfortable and natural speaking with American customers.

- Very smart, quick-thinking and able to learn new products and systems quickly.

- Strong common sense and judgment.

- A natural salesperson who enjoys closing sales.

- Someone who genuinely cares that the customer is taken care of after the sale as well.

- Strong follow-up. You do not forget open issues.

- Organized and able to multitask.

- Comfortable working quickly in a busy environment.

- Able to solve problems independently instead of immediately asking a manager what to do.

- Reliable and responsive with coworkers and management.

- Comfortable using online systems, chat,
 and e-commerce tools.

Experience with appliances, furniture, electronics, e-commerce or another high-ticket product is a strong plus.



Hours

This is a 40-hour-per-week position working U.S. Eastern Time:

Sunday: 11:00 AM–4:00 PM

Monday–Thursday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM

Friday: 10:00 AM–1:00 PM

For applicants in the Philippines, this is an overnight schedule.

Please apply only if you are comfortable working these hours consistently, staying fully awake and focused throughout your shift, and making this schedule part of your normal routine.

Some flexibility may be possible.



Pay

$1,200–$1,800 USD per month, depending on experience, ability and overall fit.

Strong candidates will be considered toward the top of the range.

Paid time off is agreed individually.



VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY

Please do not apply by only sending your resume. We receive many applications, and applications without the required video will not be reviewed.

Record a short video, about 1 minute, answering the two questions below. A simple phone video is fine. Speak naturally and do not read a prepared script.

1. This is a senior sales position. We are looking for a highly skilled, very experienced salesperson with many years of real selling behind them — not someone starting out. Are you that person? Tell me about your sales experience, and tell me is this job the right fit for you? How do you know that?

2. Above everything else, we are looking for someone who is very, very smart. Are you that person? How do you know?

Upload your video to Loom, Google Drive, YouTube (unlisted), or anywhere else you prefer and include the link with your application. Applications without the video link will not be reviewed.





This is a long-term position with real responsibility and room to grow. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the company and stay with us long-term.

title: Paid Ads Manager

Paid Ads Manager / Agency Manager



Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and results-driven Paid Ads Manager / Agency Manager to oversee the law firm’s paid digital advertising initiatives and manage relationships with external advertising agencies. This role is responsible for monitoring campaign performance, evaluating key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring compliance with legal advertising standards, and identifying opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and return on investment (ROI).



The ideal candidate has a strong background in paid digital advertising, agency management, performance analysis, and strategic marketing, with the ability to align advertising initiatives with the firm’s business objectives and growth targets.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Agency Management and Oversight



Oversee and manage external advertising agencies responsible for campaigns across Google Ads,
/Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms.



Conduct regular performance reviews, progress meetings, and strategic planning sessions with agency partners.



Establish clear expectations, performance benchmarks, and accountability measures for advertising agencies.



Ensure agencies have the necessary resources, creative assets, brand guidelines, and business information to execute 

campaigns effectively.



Monitor agency deliverables and ensure alignment with the firm’s marketing objectives and timelines.

title: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search
description:
How to Apply — IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you must complete the application form linked at the bottom of this job description. Applications submitted only through Onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.

**Please note there are no freelancer positions available within our company.

We ask that you do not continue filling out this form if you are only available as a freelancer or are only available part-time.



About Agency Hero



Agency Hero is a digital marketing company specializing in white-label SEO and WordPress services for agencies. We work behind the scenes as an extension of our agency partners' teams, helping businesses improve organic and local search visibility through SEO strategy, content, technical optimization, Local SEO, and emerging AI search strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Content Strategist to join our SEO team. This role requires strong experience developing content strategies for local and service-area businesses, as well as broader organic SEO campaigns.



This is not primarily a content writing position. We need someone who can analyze websites, local and organic search opportunities, competitors, geographic markets, search intent, and SEO data to determine what content to create or improve, why it should exist, how it should be structured, and how it fits into the overall SEO strategy.



What You'll Do

-As a Content Strategist, you will develop and improve SEO content strategies across client websites, with a significant focus on Local SEO and service-area businesses.

-Develop SEO-driven content strategies for local, service-area, regional, and broader organic campaigns.

Perform keyword research and search-intent analysis, including local and geographic search intent.

-Analyze local SERPs, organic competitors, geographic competitors, and content gaps.

Identify new content opportunities based on services, locations, search demand, competitors, and business priorities.

-Determine when service pages, city/location pages, service-area pages, supporting informational content, and other page types should be created.

-Develop service-to-location content strategies without creating unnecessary, thin, duplicative, or doorway-style pages.

-Audit existing website content and identify pages that should be improved, consolidated, expanded, redirected, or removed.

-Develop topic clusters and supporting content designed to strengthen topical and local authority.

-Map keywords, services, topics, locations, and search intent to appropriate pages.

-Plan website content architecture, including service, location, service-area, and supporting content relationships.

-Develop internal linking strategies that strengthen priority service and location pages.

-Identify and prevent keyword, topic, service, and location cannibalization.

-Create detailed content briefs for writers.

-Analyze competitor websites and SERPs to understand what is required to compete in specific markets.

-Review content for SEO effectiveness, quality, relevance, search intent, local relevance, and publication readiness.

-Consider how website content supports broader local visibility, including Google Business Profile and Map Pack performance.

-Work with other members of our SEO, Local SEO, technical, and content teams.

-Use AI tools to improve research, analysis, strategy development, and workflow efficiency.

-Help develop strategies for traditional Google Search, local search, Google AI experiences, and emerging AI-driven search platforms.



Required Experience

We are looking for candidates with demonstrated professional experience in:



-SEO content strategy.

-Local SEO content strategy for local and service-area businesses.

-Developing service-page and location-page strategies.

-Keyword research and local keyword research.

-Search-intent and geographic-intent analysis.

-Competitor and local competitor research.

-Content-gap analysis.

-Content auditing and optimization.

-Developing content plans and detailed briefs.

-On-page SEO.

-Internal linking.

-Using SEO data to make content decisions.

-Professional content writing and editing experience, with the ability to produce, improve, and evaluate publication-ready SEO content.

-Working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms in professional SEO or content workflows.



This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



Local SEO Knowledge

Candidates should have strong working knowledge of:



-Local search intent and geographic keyword targeting.

-Service-page strategy.

-City and location-page strategy.

-Service-area business SEO.

-Local content architecture and service-to-location relationships.

-Local competitor and SERP analysis.

-Determining when location-specific pages are justified by search intent and business needs.

-Avoiding thin, duplicate, templated, or doorway-style local pages.

-Local keyword and content cannibalization.

-Internal linking for service and location pages.

-Building topical relevance around priority services and markets.

-The relationship between website content, Google Business Profile, organic local results, and Map Pack visibility.

-Multi-location and multi-market content considerations.



Advanced SEO Skills

Strong candidates should also understand:



-Topical authority and topic clustering.

-Content architecture.

-Keyword, entity, and topic mapping.

-E-E-A-T principles.

-YMYL considerations.

-Search intent.

-Content cannibalization.

-Internal linking strategy.

-Competitor analysis.

-SEO content auditing.

title: AI Content QA Specialist - Local SEO
description:
How to Apply — IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you must complete the application form linked at the bottom of this job description. Applications submitted only through Onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.

ABOUT AGENCY HERO

Agency Hero is a digital marketing company specializing in white-label SEO and WordPress services for agencies. A significant portion of our work involves helping local and service-area businesses improve their visibility in Google Search and local search results through website content, on-page SEO, local SEO, technical optimization, and AI-assisted workflows.



We are hiring an AI Content QA Specialist with strong Local SEO knowledge to join our SEO team.



This is not primarily a content writing or SEO strategy position. Our Claude Skills and AI-assisted workflows are designed to produce work close to completion. Your responsibility is to run established workflows when assigned, critically review the output, correct appropriate issues, verify that SEO and Local SEO instructions were followed, and help move deliverables to a finished, client-ready standard.



The right person will have strong professional writing and editing skills, understand Local SEO, and know how to evaluate AI-generated content critically. You should be able to distinguish between an actual problem and a stylistic preference, make efficient corrections, and recognize when an issue should be escalated rather than guessed at.



**This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

-Review AI-generated and AI-assisted SEO and Local SEO content before approval or delivery.

-Compare completed work against the original SEO brief, client instructions, business information, target services, target locations, and workflow requirements.

-Review service pages, city/location pages, service-area pages, landing pages, blog content, and other website content used in local SEO campaigns.

-Identify thin, duplicated, overly templated, or substantially overlapping service/location content.

-Identify potential keyword, service, topic, or location cannibalization.

-Check internal linking between relevant service, location, and supporting content when required by the brief.

-Identify missed topics, weak sections, or insufficient local relevance.

-Leave clear, actionable QA notes when additional changes are required.

-Recognize when an issue can be corrected independently and when it should be escalated to an SEO strategist or another team member.

-Report recurring AI-output problems that may need to be corrected within the underlying workflow, prompt, or Claude Skill.

-Work efficiently through a consistent volume of AI-assisted deliverables without sacrificing accuracy or review standards.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



-Professional content writing and editing experience, with the ability to produce, improve, and evaluate publication-ready SEO content.

-Experience with Local SEO or reviewing content created for local and service-area businesses.

-Reviewing SEO content before publication or client delivery.

-Reviewing service pages, city/location pages, service-area content, landing pages, and blog content.

-Content editing, content quality assurance, or editorial review.

-Fact-checking and source verification.

-Working from detailed SEO or content briefs and following instructions precisely.

-Understanding how services and geographic markets should be represented within website content.

-Editing AI-generated or AI-assisted content.

-Using Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools in a professional workflow.

-Managing multiple pieces of content while maintaining consistent quality standards.

-Strong written English and the editorial judgment to recognize whether content is genuinely publication-ready.



This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



LOCAL SEO KNOWLEDGE

Candidates should have working knowledge of:



-Local search intent and geographic keyword targeting.

-Service-page optimization.

-City and location-page optimization.

-Service-area business SEO.

-Local keyword targeting and natural geographic relevance.

-Local content quality and topical relevance.

-On-page SEO for local businesses.

-Heading structure, title tags, and meta descriptions.

-Internal linking between service, location, and supporting pages.

-Thin, duplicated, templated, or substantially overlapping local content.

-The difference between genuinely useful location-specific content and generic content with city names inserted into it.

You do not need to be the person developing the entire Local SEO strategy. However, you must understand Local SEO well enough to recognize when content does not properly execute the strategy or instructions provided.



Experience with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and Local SEO/rank-tracking tools is valuable but not required for every candidate.



AI CONTENT REVIEW

AI is an important part of how our team works. You should understand that AI-generated content can appear polished while still containing significant SEO, Local SEO, factual, or editorial problems.



You should be able to recognize hallucinated or unsupported information, missed instructions, generic or repetitive AI writing, incorrect services or locations, weak geographic relevance, unnatural city/keyword insertion, duplicated local content, and content that sounds good but does not properly satisfy the intended local search intent.



Experience with Claude Projects, Claude Skills, custom GPTs, reusable prompts, or other structured AI workflows is a strong advantage, but it is not required. We care more about your ability to learn structured workflows, follow them precisely, and use AI intelligently.

-Discipline to flag unclear or missing information rather than guessing.

-Comfort learning new AI tools, Claude Skills, and evolving workflows.

-An efficient working style that balances quality with appropriate turnaround time.



POSITION DETAILS

title: AI Meta Ads Video Editor: Pixar-Style Animated Ads
description:
AI Meta Ads Video Editor: Pixar-Style Animated Ads (D2C, Family Health)



We're looking for an experienced Meta Ads video editor who creates high-performing animated ads for D2C brands.



We're building Kinded, a D2C brand for UK families with young children. Our first product is a solid titanium chopping board, made for mums who want to know their little ones' food isn't cut on plastic. The mission behind it is bigger than the product: we give families one less thing to worry about at the table. Our customers are mums of babies and young children who care deeply about what goes into a growing body, and who've quietly started wondering about the scratched plastic board they've used for years.



This role focuses on Meta ads for
 and Instagram, made mainly as Pixar-style 3D animated ads: founder story ads, mechanism and education ads, scroll-stopping top-funnel hooks, and bottom-funnel conversion ads.

We need someone with real experience making Meta creative for D2C brands. You understand what makes ads convert, not just what looks nice: hooks, clean cuts, pacing, scroll-stopping visuals, subtitles, benefit stacking, CTAs, and how to build variations that actually isolate one variable.





What makes this different from most editing roles



Read this part carefully. It's the difference between an application we reply to and one we don't.



We sell a feeling, not an object. What she's buying is the relief of not having to think about it anymore. The product appears late, briefly, as proof. If your instinct is to open on a hero product shot, this isn't your role.



We don't sell with fear. This is a family health category. Scare tactics, danger framing, and "is your child at risk?" hooks are permanently banned here. They might convert short-term, but they destroy a trust brand. Our tone is calm, warm, and evidence-led.



Animation, done with taste. Our ads are Pixar-style 3D animation: rounded characters with expressive faces that tell the story with very little dialogue. Characters must stay consistent across every scene, emotions must read clearly, and nothing should look uncanny or cheap. We never show microplastics as creatures attacking inside the body, or anything else that implies a health effect we can't prove.



Honesty is the product. We only make claims we can back up. No "knife-friendly," no invented statistics, no fake reviews. If a line in a script overclaims, we want you to flag it, not animate it.



We advertise in the UK. You need a feel for UK culture and language: chopping board, not cutting board; mum, not mom.



Meta's rules bite harder here. Copy that implies a personal attribute, or unapproved health claims, gets creatives rejected. You should already know how to land the same emotional punch without triggering a rejection.





Responsibilities

Creating Pixar-style animated Meta ads for
 and Instagram

Animating our founder story and turning it into ad variations

Making mechanism and education ads that make an invisible problem visible

Creating bottom-funnel ads focused on conversions

Adding subtitles, hooks, overlays, benefits, transitions, and CTAs

Creating multiple variations for testing: hook, first-frame, and CTA variations

Repurposing winning creatives into new versions and new angles

Keeping characters, colours, and style consistent across every ad

Working fast and delivering new creatives consistently

Communicating clearly with the team

Thinking creatively about new ad angles



Requirements

We're looking for someone who:

Has strong experience editing Meta ads for D2C brands

Has made animated or Pixar-style ads before (show us)

Understands
 and Instagram ad creatives, and current Meta ad policy in practice

Understands hooks, angles, CTAs, social proof, benefits, and objections

Can create ads made to convert, not just look beautiful

Can hold an emotional tone without it becoming sentimental, dramatic, or fear-based

Speaks and writes good English

Can work full-time and deliver consistently across the week

Is reliable, fast, and consistent

Communicates very well

Has a high EQ and works well with feedback

Takes ownership and doesn't need constant hand-holding

A background in parenting, health, food, or any other trust-led category is a strong plus.



AI skills preferred

Experience with tools like these is a strong plus:

Higgsfield

Runway

HeyGen

ElevenLabs

CapCut AI

Midjourney

ChatGPT / Claude

Descript

OpusClip

Topaz

Canva AI

Other AI video, voice, image, or editing tools



We will be fully operating on Google Flow. If you're not familiar with Google Flow, please don't apply.



We provide the tools. You'll be given Google Flow on the max subscription, a Claude account, ElevenLabs, and any other tools you need to do your best work.





Ad editing skills preferred

Strong hooks that land in the first 3 seconds, muted, as text

Fast pacing without losing an emotional beat

Pattern interrupts

Captions and subtitles

Product benefits and objection handling

Founder storytelling

Before/after structures

Clear CTAs

Multiple creative variations

Bottom-funnel conversion focus





Salary

N/A. Pay will be discussed on a call in the later stages of the hiring process.





A long-term partnership, not a one-off job

We're not looking for a freelancer to finish a few edits and move on. We want editors who grow with us as Kinded grows, take on more responsibility over time, and become part of the family. If you want stability, ownership, and a brand you're proud to build, we'd love to hear from you.





How to apply

Please answer all of the following questions. Write your answers yourself. If we can tell AI was used to answer these questions, your application will not be considered.

How many years of Meta ads video editing experience do you have?

Which D2C brands have you worked with before?

Send your best Meta ad examples.

Send examples of animated or Pixar-style ads you've made.

How long have you used Google Flow, and what have you made with it?

Do you understand bottom-funnel ad creatives? Please explain briefly.

What editing software do you use?

Here's a hook: "I'd fed him off that board for a year. Then I saw the grooves." In two or three sentences, how would you animate the first 5 seconds of that ad?

Applications without answers to all eight questions will not be reviewed.



Next step: if we like your application, we'll ask you to make a test video so we can see how you work.
